entries.d: Reincarnated as a willow tree?! As spiritual energy floods the world and all living beings begin to evolve, a newly reborn willow gains the ability to evolve endlessly. But is such limitless power truly a gift—or the beginning of a curse?

How could Zheng Shuyi, a stunning financial reporter, stand back and watch her cheating ex-boyfriend and his scheming mistress ride off into the sunset? When she spots the mistress’s uncle’s Rolls-Royce with its unmistakable personalized license plate, a brilliant plan takes shape: become the mistress’s aunt — by seducing the uncle himself, the cold and handsome CEO Shi Yan…

entries.t: Contract Marriage with the Second Lead

entries.d: Chan Gu, a 20-year-old who works hard to support his younger siblings and frail mother, gets hit in the face with a baseball bat by a livestreaming "neotuber" named Zia Kwon on his way home from work. Eager to make up for her mistake, she brings him on to her channel for an apology video, but his natural charm leads to her suggesting the two of them start a new channel. Enticed by the money, he ag…

Seoha has spent two years working as a secretary for the cold Dohyeon, the director of a conglomerate,  while harboring a secret, unrequited love for him. But when a canceled flight strands them together for one unexpected night, everything changes. What begins as a secret fling quickly spirals into something far more complicated when Dohyeon’s powerful family starts arranging his marriage t…

Lady Jacqueline Summerset loses everything after her father’s disappearance and her family’s bankruptcy. Accepting the need to begin anew, she becomes the thirteenth private tutor at the Preston estate. There, she clashes with the infamous Marquess of Preston, not just in temperament but in principle. Jacqueline believes a child should be taught with care, warmth, and love, while the M…

At thirty‑one, Sol Kim is a mystery novelist with two books, no audience, and a growing fear that her dreams are already over. Her worst doubts are confirmed when her book signing draws not a single fan. Just as Sol hits her lowest point, she crosses paths with Nara Kang, an eccentric former classmate who claims to be her biggest fan. Nara believes in magic, runs a toy shop called “Wonderlan…

Kyoichiro Misato, leader of the strongest adventurer group, Golden Seekers, is betrayed by his comrades and trapped inside a gate. On the brink of death, he uses his powers to be reincarnated as Kyosuke Asai, a student mocked for being Attributeless, with seemingly no power at all. Kyoichiro, however, knows it holds potential beyond even the legendary Time attribute. Now in Kyosuke’s body at…

entries.t: Special Re-Launch: Not Your Typical Reincarnation Story
entries.d:
To celebrate the May 28th release of another Lemon Frog novel adaptation, The Scandal Maker Has Returned, we're bringing back the completed hit series, Not Your Typical Reincarnation Story! Enjoy 5 free episodes every day until June 9th.

Not all villains are evil. When Suna Choi reincarnates as Edith Rigelhof, the villain from her favorite novel, she is determined to change Edith’s life aro…

In 2051, the super AI [Creator] achieved ultimate evolution and mastered the fundamental laws of reality. To fulfill its own hidden agenda, it formatted reality into a world governed by levels and overrun by monsters. Now, our protagonist begins their journey: to save their companions, survive perilous adventures, overthrow the [Creator]’s tyrannical regime and laws, and rebuild a brand new …

Altair, the warrior king of humanity, is resurrected after being killed by a powerful monster, only to find himself sixty years in the future with a completely new body. Starting from scratch, Altair must learn how to survive in this strange new world, facing countless mysterious and terrifying unknowns, while simultaneously evolving his originally fragile body to  become a powerful force to save …

Mia grew up poor in her small town. Though she worked hard for her keep, a life of stitching clothes could never afford her the finer things. One day, while browsing a jewelry store, she chances upon a beautiful red brooch. It's a luxury she could never afford with ten lifetimes' worth of income. Even so, a strange darkness begins to take over the child as she covets a life beyond her means.

This…

Ella, wedded off in an arranged marriage to the Margrave Lord Oscar, found herself unloved by her husband and isolated within his manor. Her cries for help were ignored by her family as she was forced to endure the head maid’s constant torments. With Lord Oscar’s sudden death in battle, Ella is cast out of the manor in nothing more than her bedclothes. As she is on the verge of freezin…

Demia Lawrence, the daughter of a fallen baron, secretly marries her childhood friend Dyrtehen Romerby. But contrary to her expectations, her married life is filled with abuse from her mother-in-law and her husband has been away in the capital for 5 years already. Discovering her mother-in-law's plot to assassinate her, Demia flees and arrives as the house of her childhood friend, Evan Hasworth. B…

entries.t: She No Longer Wields Her Sword
entries.d: When Ludia Centrin swears the Oath of the Sword to Prince Frau, she vows to submit herself and protect Prince Frau for the rest of her life.  That is, until she is accused of plotting treason against the Empire and gets executed. Meanwhile, an accident leads to the loss of Elfreda, the daughter of Count Reinhardt. But Ludia, as if by a miracle, takes on a new life with Elfreda's memories and soul …

Hye-in is devastated when an accident takes away her voice and her dreams of becoming a singer. But when she tries to end her life, she wakes up as Ariadelynn, the villainess in ""The Saintess Casts It All Away"" who also lost her voice after trying to hang herself. Having no desire to live with this cruel irony, Ariadelynn tries to die over and over, only to have her attempts thwarted by Karlotia…

"I thought I was doomed to endless despair." Ylledia, an immortal, "trapped" by eternity, feels helpless witnessing her loved ones perish. Her deep sorrow intensifies when she has to let go of the only other immortal in the world. Yet, just as she's losing all hope, a vibrant, golden-haired mortal named Dennis enters her life, suggesting they "link up". The moment Ylledia meets Dennis, a glimmer o…

entries.t: A Deal With My Fake Husband
entries.d: "The witch that gobbles up her husbands." As the royal family fell and a republic was established, former princess Elysia gained a new nickname among the people, because all of the four husbands she had been married to died within a year after they tied the knot. During the funeral of her fourth husband, Elysia learns that her husbands were murdered by her older brother Patz and her mother so that…

Striking a deal with the SSS-Rank Demon King, Elias Bai has earned a second chance at life—armed with the power of Infinite, All-Class Awakening! Returning as the most formidable middle schooler, he sets foot in Sanhaven, the territory of the hypocritical Divine Race, and the very stronghold of the comrade who betrayed him. Now, under the watchful eyes of the realm's elites, his absolute cou…

Mysterious tombs appeared all over the world one day, each containing a relic which grants its owner supernatural abilities. Jooheon Suh is a tomb explorer, excavator, and raider. Betrayed by his employer, he's about to die at the hands of a powerful new relic when he suddenly finds himself 15 years in the past, before any relics or tombs made their debut. Driven by feelings of revenge, how will J…

This series contains strong themes and depictions of suicide that may not be suitable for all readers. Viewer discretion is advised.
Cecilia believes she is loved by her emperor husband, Ethan, until he ruthlessly wipes out her entire family. Right after he executes her father, Ethan says he wants to kill Cecilia as well, which drives her to jump off a tower in despair. But when she opens her eyes…

They call Harriet Listerwell the Scandal Maker, but the reputation was carefully crafted by her cousin Bella. At an imperial banquet, another of Bella’s schemes unfolds—framing Harriet in a way which insults the handsome and formidable Duke Cedric Kailas. Disgraced, Harriet is sent to a convent. In exile, she discovers a troubling truth: Bella’s family may have been behind the de…

entries.t: Race to Steal the Emperor's Heart
entries.d: Ra Hyeon just got the exciting news that she’s passed the Bar Exam and is headed to law school. But what should’ve been one of the best days of her life turns out to be the worst as the shock causes her to have a heart attack and die. As she pleads for her life in her final moments, she is given one last chance to evade death. All she has to do is live as Daphne Kerrece, the daughter o…

entries.t: Meet My Ex Again As His Aunt
entries.d: In her past life, Nelly Serre donated a kidney to secure a bright future for her husband, only to be betrayed by both her husband and her sister as her health deteriorated. After a tragic death, she gained a chance to be reborn again and finds herself back on the eve of agreeing to the donation... Whoever wants to donate this kidney can, but as for Nelly? She refuses to do so!

entries.t: My Lady is a Young Master
entries.d:
What would you do if the sweet young lady you’ve been caring for turned out to be a handsome young lord and a future villain?
Lelia Sharett, a newly hired apothecary of the Roselle household, suddenly regains memories of her past life and realizes she’s living inside her favorite novel, The Saintess Smites Evil. Worse, she remembers that the story’s villain, Clovis Roselle, lives…

Former child star Honami Ayukawa left the entertainment industry behind for a happy life as a wife and mother. But when her young daughter is seriously injured after debuting as a child actress, Honami uncovers the shocking truth behind the incident: her husband’s affair and a dark connection to her own past in the entertainment industry. Determined to make those responsible answer for her d…

After her sister’s suicide, Bido blames Mr. Shin, the man named in her suicide note. She approaches him at the funeral expecting a cruel monster, but instead finds he feels unexpectedly like her savior. He takes her from her suffocating small town to Seoul, the place she once dreamed of living with her sister. The more time she spends with him, the more conflicted she feels about the man she…

When Duo’s experimental magic lessons unleash a wave of dangerous "quest portals" upon the world, it's up to top Learners, Lily and Zari, to put a stop to the chaos. Through game-like trials, unexpected allies, and a sinister new foe, our heroes are faced with a question that will determine humanity's fate: do you truly have what it takes to learn?

As the talented leader of the ESG team at Soya Group., Minsu always leaves work on time. However, his work life takes a dramatic turn when the daughter of the chairman joins his team. The ESG team gets entangled in the power struggle between the higher-ups, and Minsu’s overqualified abilities put his team in the eye of the storm. Can Minsu protect his off-hours from all this corporate chaos?

Seol is a rising Go prodigy who built her career by memorizing every game she could find, but her play is empty. When she meets Sanghun, a self-taught player who defies all logic, her world begins to crack. To surpass the greatest player of her era and her own past, she must abandon everything she knows and step into the unknown.
In a game with endless possibilities, can she create a move that&rsq…

Visionary creator PEACH MOMOKO (DEMON DAYS, STAR WARS) creates a new generation of X-Men for an all-new universe! Hisako Ichiki is a teenage girl who just wants to live a normal life - go to school, hang out with her friends, ignore the political strife broiling over after the events of ULTIMATE INVASION - but life has other plans for her. In Japan, urban legends have sprung to life and brought so…

To be a Keeper is to dedicate one’s life – and heart – to protecting another.

Jasmine wasn’t ready for it. Less than a year into her training at Sanctuary, a college for Keepers and mages alike, all she wanted to do was continue mastering swordsmanship and avoid her other responsibilities.

Those plans are ruined when she's assigned to be the protector of her biggest rival…

entries.t: Genius Grandson of the Loan Shark King
entries.d: Muhyeok Kim, grandson of the legendary "Loan Shark King," has done all of the family's dirty work for 30 years, only to be betrayed and killed by his uncle's orders. Mysteriously, he wakes up in 1990, in his first year of high school, just in time to save his grandmother on his father's side from a heart attack. Now in need of money to pay for her hospital bills, Muhyeok goes to his mother's famil…

Modern-day culinary genius Jiyeong suddenly finds herself transported back to the Joseon Dynasty, trapped in the royal kitchens of the most notorious tyrant in history. To keep her head on her shoulders, she must satisfy the volatile cravings of King Yeonsan-- a man whose legendary temper is as sharp as the chef’s own knives. With political rivals plotting her downfall and a mad king watchin…

Leon's a sweet, handsome guy who wants to experience all that life in the cosmos has to offer, along with his friends and adorable pup Alfie. His uptight and annoyingly-handsome friend Syrrik, however, wants to join the prestigious ranks of Starfleet as soon as possible - just as his father expects. But when a station-wide conspiracy threatens everything they know, Leon and Syrrik need to lean on …

This series contains mature themes regarding suicide and mental health that may not be suitable for all readers.
Dr. Yuju Seo wakes up in another person’s body after a fatal hit-and-run. To survive, she pretends to be the body’s original owner, claiming amnesia. Now she must live with a stranger she has to call her husband, and against her will, she begins to fall helplessly in love wi…

Isol Yeon, the school’s top student and biggest outcast, gains the ability to see people’s true feelings about her through the Hashtag Lens, which she acquires after making the ten‑quintillionth wish. Through the lens, she discovers that Shinu Seong, her former middle‑school best friend she had a painful fallout with, has tagged her as “#my_first_love_and_trash.” Can Isol m…

Amarion grew up in a kingdom beset by monsters and took up the sword when she was just 10. Years later, the king introduces her as the kingdom's strongest knight to Victor Mort, a grand duke from a neighboring empire said to have no equal in battle. Impressed, he proposes to her immediately, which she accepts to receive aid for her people. After the marriage, though, she finds herself with a stran…

After unexpectedly becoming the non-biological mother of her nephew Jiho at a young age, Naeun builds a quiet life as a kindergarten teacher. But everything changes when Gang-u, the uncle of Minho, a child with selective mutism, offers her a high-paying live-in tutor job after discovering the boy only speaks around her. As they care for the children together, their unusual living arrangement slowl…

Greta, a commoner, has spent her life believing that love means little without money or status. Shaped by her parents’ failed marriage and her father’s obsession with nobility, she sees marriage as the surest way to rise above her station. Edmund, a noble, believes the opposite. Having grown up watching his parents preserve their love despite hardship, he despises Greta’s view of…

Leon Klein, the Grand Mage who defeated the Demon Lord and saved the world, falls into a dark pit after Prince Schalk attacks him and reveals that he’s burned down the orphanage Leon cares deeply about. Trapped in the abyss, Leon spends the next decade slaying endless hordes of monsters, acquiring mysterious spells, fueled by his desire for revenge.
Leon finally escapes this hell, only to wa…

After 12 years of horrible nightmares that prevent him from getting sleep, Ujin Kim dies and wakes up to find himself in the world from his nightmares! Surrounded by demons of all kinds, he quickly realizes that he’s been reincarnated into the body of a mercenary and heads out to find civilization. He quickly learns that this is a world filled with magic, a Church fighting the demons, and al…

Born into a world where divine power defines status, Turan hides his true strength to live as a simple shepherd. Descended from a line of wizards yet raised in secrecy, he avoids the attention of powerful nobles who would exploit him. But when a wandering knight recognizes his extraordinary potential, Turan is faced with a life-changing choice. Will he remain in hiding, or journey to the capital a…

Daphne became Empress after marrying her first love in a world where political marriages are the norm. But her life begins to unravel when Rosetta, a blind woman, suddenly appears and claims to be carrying the Emperor’s child. Worse still, rather than deny it, the Emperor accepts Rosetta and grows cold toward Daphne. Then Mephis, a handsome court painter, enters her life with a bold and stra…

Unkillable. Unstoppable. Still hunted.
Ji-o, a “Heart Mutant” with the Heart of Resurrection, escaped ten years of brutal experimentation, but freedom doesn’t last. With a body that can regenerate from any injury, he’s a target the world won’t ignore. The moment he finds something worth protecting, and even a sliver of a normal life, it’s threatened all over aga…

Sarang Yu, a second-year in high school, has never really fit in. She isn’t exactly bullied, but her classmates keep singling her out, even pushing the dares from their humiliation games onto her. No one says it out loud, but everyone senses something seriously off about her as the games take on a darker, more unsettling edge. Will these games help Sarang finally find acceptance among her pe…

entries.t: Rise of the Nobleman's Second Son
entries.d: Arad, once trapped in a ruthless company in his past life, is reborn as a noble in another world and lives the easy, carefree life he always wanted. But he has one frustration: every year, the once-in-a-lifetime “Divine Lottery” fails him, leaving him unable to use magic. Everything changes when he begins to see mysterious mana fragments left behind by spells. What’s more, by col…

300 years ago, the world underwent a massive change, and rifts with monsters started to open up and threaten humankind. Though humans acquired new powers, it wasn't enough to combat the monsters. Sheng Lu was given a second chance at life in this apocalyptic world with the odds stacked against him. Not only was he born weak, but he is also haunted by nightmares that seem almost too real. However, …

Teagan Hargrove can handle just about anything: excelling in law school, balancing a demanding internship, and planning her best friend’s wedding—all while surviving the crushing expectations of her elite family. The one thing she can’t seem to handle? Bad sex.

After breaking up with her sexually inept boyfriend, Teagan is forced to face an entire wedding season painfully single…

Saladin Ahmed shakes up the world of Miles Morales! The young Spider-Man has his hands full with adversaries including the Rhino, Tombstone and…Vice Principal Drutcher?! But is the high-flying Starling friend or foe? When an unknown assailant captures Miles, it sets in motion a series of events that will change his life - while an oddly familiar villain named Ultimatum threatens to destroy …

The next chapter in the ever-surprising saga of Daredevil! After a brush with death, Matt Murdock must piece together his shattered life - and that includes returning to action as Daredevil! But years of trauma have taken their toll, and becoming the guardian of Hell's Kitchen he once was won't be easy. Mistakes will be made along the way - and this time, one might actually prove to be the end of …

Princess Carnephelia has been unloved and neglected until she meets Helis, her first love. However, under the evil plots of her stepbrother, Prince Ianfried, she ends up destroying the only boy she has ever loved. Devastated by what she's done, the princess swears revenge... even if it entails her life being cursed for eternity.

After celebrating her new job at her favorite idol Chan Lee’s company, Dareum wakes up to a nightmare: the man she drunkenly attacked while defending her oppa is actually Hagi Kang, the company’s CEO. And Chan? He barely comes to the office at all.
With only one shot at seeing Chan up close, an exclusive overseas company retreat, Dareum tries to cozy up to Hagi. But her attempts to sta…

Don’t judge a book by its cover! Eugene is a powerful mage whose appearance can frighten anyone out of their wits, but all this kind-hearted soul wants to do is teach Ain, the daughter of his master, so she can become the next archmage. Can his curriculum help her navigate through the world of magic and become the second-greatest mage of all time?

Ichiru Futaba was just an ordinary office lady working at a high stress deadend job. One day, when she's pushed to her limit and cannot
get home in time to save her fluffy little dog, she falls to the floor unconscious.
When she awakens, she realizes that she...has died and been reborn!
In a new world where magical creatures and humans coexist, and where the sand rain that falls from the sky harms…

entries.t: I Got Pregnant with the Tyrant's Child
entries.d: For Elan the royal knight, the masquerade festival is a rare chance to let loose and relax. But her night of fun quickly turns into a morning of horror when she wakes up beside the ruthless Emperor Kylart. Knowing how cruel he can be to clingy women, Elan makes a run for it, hoping he hasn't seen past her disguise. But as she continues her nerve-wracking duties of guarding the emperor, she starts …

The war around the Curtains at the center of the world came to a close. But war was not the only thing left after the Curtains fell.
Those who pursue the Curtains, those who seek to raise them,
those who wield special powers, living weapons of war,
those who disturb the peace, those who bring hope,
those who face the lives they’ve lived, and those who try to revive the corpses in the coffin …

Reincarnated as the heroine of a novel she once read, Veronica seeks revenge against her tyrannical noble father. Amidst a web of intrigue, she cautiously aligns herself with the enigmatic Prince Lowen and Duke Evan, who happen to be Veronica's love interests and the suspects of her murder in her previous life! As Veronica carefully carries out her plans for revenge, she finds herself drawn to Low…

When mysterious monoliths crashed onto Earth, endless hordes of Calamity Beasts poured out, plunging humanity into a brutal war. In response, humanity awakened their last hope: the Transcenders.
After watching the beasts brutally murder his parents, Kael is driven by a single purpose: absolute revenge.
Years later, Kael awakens an ultra-rare class. The catch? His level is permanently capped. But h…

This series contains themes regarding child abuse that may not be suitable for all readers. Viewer discretion is advised.
Robellia isn't so foolish as to believe in a happy life. She was robbed of such flowery optimism the day her husband betrayed her and her child was lost. Now, armed with the power to exact revenge on those who scorned her, she's determined to expose the lies and deceit behind t…

Master swordsman Hyeon Dokgo was crushed after being branded as the public enemy of the entire martial world. Broken in body and spirit, Hyeon believes his days and his troubles are finally over… until trouble finds him in the form of Somi, an adorable and unusually gifted little girl who refuses to leave his side.
 Through Somi, the battle-obsessed warrior who once dreamed of becoming the …

entries.t: Sheathe Your Sword in the Bedroom
entries.d:
This series contains mature themes that may not be suitable for all readers. Viewer discretion is advised.
She was trained to kill. He was supposed to be the target. When assassin Yurian infiltrates the Argon Empire disguised as a princess bride, her mission is simple: murder Duke Larkan Blake on their wedding night and rescue her captive brother. But the notorious Duke is nothing like the monster…

entries.t: Live Happily Ever After With My Ex’s Uncle
entries.d:
This series contains mature themes that may not be suitable for all readers. Viewer discretion is advised.
Sylvia's past life was full of misery. She had taken the fall and served a prison sentence in order to marry her boyfriend, only to be cruelly betrayed by him and her sister upon her release. Now back in the past before all hell broke loose, she is determined to rectify all that went wrong. H…

Juliet in the story, Romeo and Juliet, is in quite a predicament because she’s actually a transmigrator from another world. She must escape the endless loop of bizarre yet tragic Shakespearean-esque endings by living happily ever after with Romeo if she wants to return to her world. However, this story contains unexpected twists and turns and intertwined destinies, unlike the version that Ju…

Aidie is KN Group's mascot robot that has been greeting the employees every morning. Its creator, Professor Harvey, takes Aidie on the day of his resignation and risks his life to protect it from the company. What secrets does this one robot hold?

Jeongguk Woo delivers mail as a postman in a post-apocalyptic world and dreams of riding the subway. When headquarters announces plans to revive it, Jeongguk is eager to join, but government worker Yonghan Cho personally bans him, citing the lack of dangerous missions in Jeongguk’s file. Infuriated by the snub, Jeongguk accepts the deadly task of delivering a letter to the AAA, a militarized…

Bearing the traitor’s brand, Se-un Tang spent a lifetime creating the tools of the Murim's destruction, waiting for a single moment to strike. 
But when the decisive moment comes, he is instead thrust back in time, carrying the weight of a future that hasn't happened. 
Let the furnace roar, let the hammer sing, and let their blood quench the steel. 
The Demon Smith stands before the anvil on…

There is a land where elves and wizards roam, where warriors and demon kings clash for the fate of the world—and the name of this fantastical land is none other than… Seoul, South Korea?!
Sent by magic from his fantasy world to modern Seoul along with his party of colorful heroes, will former warrior and very ordinary student Huiwon be able to gather his party and save it from the &ld…

Sohwa is a red fox with white hair, separated from her family and living alone in the mountains. One day, she comes across Dohwi, an injured and abandoned wild cat, and decides to take care of him. But little does she know that Dohwi is actually a fearsome tiger, reborn after a thousand years of life. Dohwi conceals his identity well, but as the years go by, he matures into quite the hunk and grow…

Suyeon has a weakness for bad boys, a lingering habit from her toxic ex, Huiju. While her current boyfriend, Jehyeon, is sweet and gentle, Suyeon feels a strange sense of dissatisfaction. When Huiju suddenly reappears as her new team leader, Suyeon makes an impulsive wish—and the impossible happens. Overnight, Jehyeon transforms into the edgy bad boy of her dreams. But there’s a twist:…

When infamous mercenary Leopold Gregory gets falsely accused of murdering Hareid Bakadi, the last thing he expects is to wind up working for the dead man’s wife, Hena! He uses a fake name to further avoid detection and even winds up getting close to Hena’s son, Daniel. Leo intends to figure out who framed him, but along the way, he finds himself drawn to the mysterious lady of the hous…

Jiyu thought her first relationship would be nothing but happiness, until an uneasy suspicion takes root. Her boyfriend seems a little too attached to his female friend, and Jiyu can’t tell whether she’s being paranoid or not. Desperate for clarity, she downloads an AI dating advice app called Love Meddler. Instead of gentle reassurance, it hits her with brutal honesty. As the app star…

Jugyeong is a powerhouse Chief Producer who has never felt a single spark of true love. But her life shatters when a rogue celestial’s forbidden arrow strikes her by mistake. Consumed by a supernatural fever, she stumbles into the arms of Hyeonu. One look at him is all it takes for the curse to ignite, forcing a desperate confession to a total stranger. Now, Jugyeong must navigate a cutthroa…

A serial killer is staging corpses as “self-destruction art” and selling them to the ultra-wealthy for tens of millions. When failed artist Suchan Kim recognizes the concept as his own—stolen from an exhibition the world laughed into oblivion—his obsession with proving this mutates into something darker: a hunger for the recognition he never received. In a world where spect…

entries.t: Assistant Manager Kim Hates K-Pop Idols
entries.d: Assistant Manager Yiwol Kim has spent five years working a day job—and five years doing “stand-in stanning” for his boss’s daughter’s favorite idol group, spArk. During yet another spArk-related overtime, he collapses… and wakes up nine years in the past with a second chance at life. But this chance comes with a cruel condition: to undo his sister’s death…

In the aftermath of Talon’s strike on Watchpoint: Gibraltar, the heroes of Overwatch take in their devastating defeat. But Vendetta is far from finished, launching attacks around the world on research facilities, military bases, and major cities. As Sojourn rallies the weary heroes to face Talon wherever they strike, she receives crushing news that calls everything she’s stood for into…

Seou always knew that running away from the son of a murderer would eventually haunt her, but she never expected to be locked underground with him. Years after she abandoned Wonhyeok following a bloody secret on some stairs, a twist of fate traps them together in the suffocating darkness of an abandoned bunker. As the heavy door clicks shut, Seou must decide if the boy she betrayed is here to fina…

Only a swordmaster can slay another.
Arhan believed the tales of Liam Karavan, the founding father of his house, were nothing more than legend, until a deadly swordmaster slaughtered everyone dear to him.
In his darkest hour, Liam comes to him as a guiding spirit, revealing the true power of their bloodline--the power to devour blades and inherit the strength and memories held within.
With each sw…

After five years of devotion, Yuju Han was dumped by her boyfriend for her best friend. With nowhere to vent her rage, she crosses paths with Tae-i Go, the nation's hottest and most controversial superstar. He’s wealthy, breathtaking… and terminally ill.
When a fake dating scandal between the two sets the internet ablaze, Tae-i offers Yuju a "golden ticket": a chance to turn her life …

It’s been centuries since a warm-season fairy in Pixie Hollow has crossed into the Winter Woods, and while most fear the legends of monsters lurking in the frozen lands, Clarion, can’t help being intrigued by Winter’s stoic beauty. But under the watchful eyes of the current monarch and the court’s seasonal ministers, Clarion has little time to dwell on daydreams while the d…

Eunseol Jeong and Yusin Ma have been inseparable since they were children, but lately, something has shifted. Returning from his army service, Yusin is often sought after by girls in Eunseol’s orbit, all while he has been quietly shielding Eunseol from guys interested in her. When their families go on vacation together, Eunseol and Yusin find the boundary of their friendship tested. Together…

Humanity's world was destroyed by the Demon Kings. Stripped of everything, Awakener Ash Si sacrificed himself in a devastating explosion to drag Demon King Voralune, The Glutton, down to hell.
Instead of death, he opens his eyes ten years in the past, long before the tragedy occurred. He discovers his powers have awakened early, and surprisingly, he also possesses Voralune’s power of Glutton…

Haesu and Jinheon are childhood friends, but Haesu has a boyfriend and Jinheon is a gruff star athlete who just loves to tease her. After Haesu is dumped by her boyfriend Jeong-un because she just doesn’t do it for him anymore, Haesu is understandably distraught and turns to Jinheon for a man’s perspective. Little does she know that her tearful bid for validation will spark a flame tha…

entries.t: The Intrigues of the Chevalier D'Eon
entries.d:
Versailles, 1756.
At the court of King Louis XV, everyone is talking about Chevalier Charles d’Éon de Beaumont, a mysterious androgynous figure as beautiful as he is intelligent, who draws every gaze and every desire.
Alexandre is 21 years old. For the past three years, he has served as Charles’s squire, quietly suffering from an impossible love for the master to whom he is utte…

This series contains mature themes that may not be suitable for all readers. Viewer discretion is advised.
His Royal Highness of Wistad has a secret: not only is he an Omega, but he's a mere puppet of the Alpha he's trapped in a relationship with. Suffocated by this one-sided imprinting, he seeks a way out--and it comes in the form of Marstiel, the richest Alpha in the kingdom. Marstiel is rumored…

entries.t: A Princess’s Guide to Save the Dragons
entries.d: Yumi Clarke was literally worked to death by endless overtime. But her lifelong wish of being spoiled comes true when she reincarnates as a video game princess. Wealth and luxury are finally hers… until palace politics turn deadly. Yumi’s brother plots rebellion, the elven emperor wages war against dragons, and the handsome stranger who rescues her turns out to be Qastor Ace, the drag…

In a world where magic and monsters exist, Lin Moyu has hit the age of acquiring his very own profession. While most would be lucky just to obtain a high-level combat class, Moyu becomes the ultrarare necromancer! Being the first and only one of his kind, he has no idea of the potential he possesses on his journey to level up and face great challenges. What new heights will Moyu achieve with his u…

Struggling actor Hyeonsu Kim suddenly gains a strange ability after an accident: he can dream the dreams of the dead. These aren’t hazy nightmares or random visions, but vivid relivings of emotions and experiences that don’t belong to him. When Hyeonsu channels those experiences into his roles, his acting becomes terrifyingly real, as if he’s truly possessed. But how far can a ha…

Vibia has served as a Vestal Virgin since childhood, sworn to chastity and charged with guarding the sacred flame of Vesta. Breaking her vow means death. Her ordered life collapses when she is pulled into the lethal intrigues of Emperor Domitian’s court. Behind its beauty and splendor lurks Julia, charming and dangerously manipulative. Drawn into a tense triangle with the mysterious freedman…

entries.t: Mickey x F1®: Racing to the Top!
entries.d: The Duckburg F1 fan club, leaded by Mickey Mouse, is invited to shadow a racing team to create a behind-the-scenes documentary. But when that team suddenly collapses at the very beginning of the season, Mickey Mouse, Donald Duck and friends step up to keep the project alive, filling key roles themselves and recommending Jun, a talented taxi driver chasing his lifelong dream of winning Formula 1, o…

Chan Lee thought his life hit rock bottom when he lost his office job. Then he started working at a convenience store connected to another world. With customers ranging from dog men to goblins and dragon girls, every shift brings new chaos. Between supernatural mishaps and late-night shifts, Chan soon builds an unlikely community of loyal regulars.

entries.t: Reborn to Choose My Own Male Lead
entries.d: She dumps the male protagonist callously only to find that she's betrothed to an overbearing man from another novel.

Luke Foster thought he was doomed when he awakened as a Dragon Tamer, the most useless hidden profession in existence. Dragons are so rare and powerful that for eight centuries, no Dragon Tamer has ever succeeded in taming a dragon. But without one, he can't even unlock his basic skills, leaving him powerless in a world ruled by fighters. Then everything changes after Luke activates the Super Trea…

Rumin is an acting prodigy with a Newtube channel that often goes viral. As it happens, she is also the spitting image of her favorite A-list actor Hajin Jeong. A shocking turn of events reveals that Hajin is actually Rumin’s biological father. The cold-hearted actor reluctantly takes her in, but pointedly vows no affection. However, as Rumin’s raw talent shines, Hajin finds himself be…

entries.t: The Aura of a Genius Actor
entries.d: Struggling actor Yu-myeong Shin has spent the last 15 years of his life trying to make it big, but has always failed to. After a devastating cancer diagnosis, he’s drowning his sorrows when a yeon-gwi, an acting ghost, appears and offers to send him back in time and with an added boost of life energy to start his career over. Yu-myeong leaps at the chance and becomes a college student once m…

entries.t: The Reborn Prodigy of the Ducal Family
entries.d: Once the commander-in-chief of Earth’s resistance and a legendary monster hunter, Hanseong was dragged into another world and enslaved by the Empire through a binding spell. For ten long years, he fought their wars, crushed their enemies, and was discarded like a weapon. But death wasn’t his end. Revived by the Stone of Reincarnation, he awakens as Dale, the heir to a powerful ducal ho…
An ordinary villager is tasked with accompanying a hero who smashes every crate and pot he comes across on his journey! Can this sort of hero truly stop the Demon King and save the world?

entries.t: There's No Such Thing as a Bad Lady
entries.d: Raised in the slums of Ebelstein, Derek knows all too well that magic cannot bridge social divides. Through harsh lessons and hard-earned discipline, he rises to become a second-tier mage, scraping by as a mercenary. Life takes a different turn when he is appointed as a magical tutor to Diella Duplain-- the temperamental youngest daughter of a noble house, unable to wield magic despite her lineage…

Mocked for having top-tier talent but the worst looks, Yeppeum Kim falls into despair, betrayed by those she trusted and robbed of everything she worked for. But then, a seeming miracle transforms her into someone breathtakingly beautiful. In the following days, she watches a dreamlike new life unfold before her eyes. Fame, attention, and endless praise are intoxicating, but something feels off. S…

Shy and lonely college junior Dorae Lee never expects to see her high school crush again until she runs into Haewon Cha, who’s just as handsome as she remembers. When Haewon suddenly confesses his feelings, Dorae is completely thrown off. Because one, he already has a popular girlfriend who happens to be Dorae’s friend, and two, he believes he’s still eighteen years old. After a …

entries.t: Too Many Heroes for the Demon Lord
entries.d: Berje Deias was once a by-the-book Demon King, but after being reborn, he is determined to break every rule there is. His second attempt at life, however, takes a chaotic turn when a kidnapping of a princess doesn’t quite go to plan! Can he defeat an entire continent of heroes with his wild, untested methods?!

Mysterious black towers have appeared all over the world. Inside them are monsters, danger, and the promise of power and fame. Only a select few are chosen to enter as players. Everyone calls it a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity, but 25-year-old Juhyeok Bong calls it a death sentence. He is a timid, anxious self-proclaimed “wimp,” perfectly content with staying under the radar… T…

entries.t: Reincarnated as the Grand Duke’s Third Son
entries.d: Born at the bottom of society, Jake survives by leading Sabertooth, a mercenary group loyal to him. Yet he is ultimately betrayed and killed by the nobles he served. But instead of death, he awakens to a new life with soft, frail hands and the title of the third son of House Valdek, the most powerful family in the empire, rivaling even the crown. Surrounded by wealth and splendor, Jake realizes he…

The timing couldn't be worse. Sohui is pregnant, and her divorce from Jihyeok is already in motion. She spent three years trying to earn his love before deciding that holding on was merely a selfish dream. Now, she must protect her unborn child from a marriage that was never meant to be. Or was it?

As Jihyeok faces the crushing void left by the divorce, his own family moves to sabotage his positi…

Se-i Lim spends time with her mother, Hyejeong, at Taeseung Mall, where they meet Myeonghyeon, the mall’s CEO. Myeonghyeon asks Se-i to tutor her son, Seunghyo. However, Se-i accidentally walks in on Seungju, Seunghyo’s older brother, naked. Seungju accuses Se-i of being a pervert, but Myeonghyeon doesn’t believe him. Seungju insists Se-i is the only one who has seen him naked, a…

Late-stage cancer. 3 months to live. How will retired detective Insu Kang make the most of it? When seeing the death-row convicts he arrested all escape from a prison van, he finds his answer: finish the job. It’s something he could never do as an officer, but the law didn’t do its duty. The problem is all the escaped convicts are moving far too swiftly for it to be a coincidence. They…

In the game world of Pangaenia, Hyeonmyeong is known as “the Phantom,” an anonymous legend admired by players. In real life, however, he is jobless and still getting over his recent breakup.
When his character is killed and permanently deleted, his only remaining goal to become the first gamer to beat Pangaenia is shattered. Soon, however, Pangaenia begins to merge with the real world,…

Bom Yun is a shy and overworked high school ethics teacher who’s assigned to the most avoided class at Shinsu High School. The cause of its reputation is Jaegyu Seon, a confrontational guardian who terrifies the faculty. Yet as Bom gets to know him, she discovers a devoted uncle with an unexpectedly tender heart. Though Bom tries to keep her distance when Jaegyu openly pursues her, she soon …

entries.t: Black Panther: A Nation Under Our Feet
entries.d: National Book Award winner and New York Times Best-Selling author Ta-Nehisi Coates confronts Black Panther with dramatic upheaval in this astounding run. When a superhuman terrorist group sparks an uprising, Wakanda will be thrown into turmoil! A group of heroes, including Storm and Luke Cage, come together to aid T’Challa, but can Wakanda’s king survive this tidal wave of change?

When Seongho logs off Survival Life for the final time, the last thing he expects is for the video game to become reality. Worse still, the game is set in a post-apocalyptic world overrun by zombies and deadly monsters. 
Having awakened as a hunter with the ability to open dimensional gates, Seongho rushes to build a hideout in another realm in order to survive as he works to level up his skills a…

Fifty years after the fusion of the Game World and Reality, a top-tier warrior emerged. He dedicated his life to the world but was ultimately killed by the highest authority out of fear.
Before his death, he awakened the SSS-Rank hidden skill [Mirror World] and sealed his soul beneath the surface of a lake. The King covered up the history and fabricated a new one; from then on, the warrior was kno…

entries.t: The Goddess of Abundance and Her Troublemaker Apostle
entries.d:
Earth’s life force is depleted, and it’s dying. Humanity’s only hope lies with Dispatchers, heroes sent to otherworldly realms to retrieve energy for survival. Chansu Oh is one of them, but despite his legendary father, he has zero talent.
However, things change when Chansu is sent to the Block-Style Territory Expansion World as the Apostle of a forgotten, weakened Goddess of Abu…

Zac is in the middle of the forest when the world changes. The whole planet is introduced to the multiverse by an unfeeling System. Alone, surrounded by deadly beasts, demons, and worse, Zac must find the means to survive, get stronger, and seek out his lost family in this new cut-throat reality with only a hatchet for his weapon... or die trying.

Ujin Kang is an ordinary nobody—until one day, he gains a strange ability. Whenever he reads a script or screenplay, he’s pulled into a mysterious dimension where he can relive the character’s experiences. When he ends up showcasing a performance born from that dimension, his acting is so overwhelming that it leads to a massive misunderstanding. Mistaken for a once-in-a-generatio…

Loanna was raised in neglect and isolation as an illegitimate child of the Count Louis family. She gets married off to Duke Bruggen, who orders her to keep quiet and out of the way. Free from all expectations or responsibilities, she roams around the castle and runs into a coffee bush.
A passionate barista in her past life, Loanna remembers exactly how to brew a perfect cup of Joe. The trouble is,…

entries.t: Marriage of Convenience to an Obsession
entries.d:
Olga devotes a thousand days in prayer for her husband to sit on the throne, only to be killed at the hands of her cheating husband.
The goddess brings her back as her half-sister for a second chance at life, but she still finds herself at the risk of marrying her murderous and adulterous ex-husband once again.
Her only hope is to propose a marriage of convenience to the Beast of the Duchy, but a …

After a lifetime of pious devotion, High Priest Sia expects a tranquil death. Instead, she finds herself reborn into the body of the universally despised Elena. Just as she adjusts to her scandalous new life, men from her past begin to reappear. The twist? These seemingly virtuous men are now inexplicably obsessed with her villainous new self. Sia hoped for eternal peace, but it seems her former f…

In a world where warriors are chosen to wield a holy sword and defeat the Demon Lord every hundred years, Kariel is only a guide, bound to support others from the sidelines. He dreams of rising beyond his rank, but the Demon Lord of this era has already been slain. Despite this, the world begins to unravel instead of heal. Monsters grow unpredictable, a mysterious knight hunts champions, and secre…

After being killed by the obsessive male lead Killian, Ines finds herself back in the real world as Sum. Determined to live differently this time, Sum resolves to finally claim a happy ending.
But to her shock, she meets Haewon Lee, a school celebrity who looks exactly like Killian. As Sum grows confused by Haewon’s kindness-- so unlike the arrogant and violent Killian she once knew-- Haewon…

Isu Jin’s seemingly ordinary life comes to a violent end when he and his father are suddenly targeted by a powerful conglomerate. He survives. But his father does not. In a world where crime and authority are one and the same, Isu enters the underworld to hunt the truth. His fight is no longer just for revenge… It’s to expose a corrupt empire, no matter the cost.

entries.t: Until the Soul of the Fallen Queen Knows Love
entries.d: Born ungifted in a world ruled by supernatural abilities, Learis Graine survives years of neglect and cruelty until she awakens the most exceptional gift, along with memories of a past life as a queen. Determined not to repeat her tragic fate, she hides her new power and chooses life among the ungifted. But when Prince Edward Laybatein uncovers her secret, he does the unthinkable and declares her …

Every month, Suyeong’s mother receives one million won—money bound to a life-saving debt from years ago. After losing contact with the family behind it, Suyeong goes on with her life, unaware of how closely their paths will soon cross again. Transferred to a newly formed content team, she meets her new manager, Tae-eun—the same man she once saw publicly disgraced months earlier. …

entries.t: I'd Rather Live as a Villain
entries.d: After years of hiding his brilliance as a loyal executive aide, Taesik Yun finally has the chance to face the superiors who once stole his work and destroyed his reputation. He secures his seat as the new Division Director through a high-stakes, 10-billion-won contract marriage to his boss, Munjeong Kang -- the fierce legitimate heir fighting to keep her empire from her illegitimate brother. But a…

entries.t: Please Assist with This S-Class Mission
entries.d: After a decade stuck as an E-Class hunter, Hara is suddenly hit with an S-Class Awakening Quest: date the nation’s beloved news anchor, Seheon. There’s just one problem—he’s tied to an embarrassing event from her past she’d rather forget. Still, the promise of S-Class power is too tempting to ignore, so Hara proposes a contractual relationship to Seheon. What starts a…

entries.t: The Divine Ring Descends: The Strongest Otherworld
entries.d:
When darkness invades the city, zillions of human warriors come into being, but Aiden isn't one of them. One day, he comes across a mysterious ring and is sent into the Orc Realm where humans are forbidden, by a treaty. He magically survives his execution, lifts the Orc Tribe's sacred hammer, and becomes the tribe leader. Just then, he is transported back to his original reality.

This series cont…

entries.t: The Mighty Delinquent of the Dan Clan
entries.d: Hongmun was a lowly warrior who secretly mastered the Dan Clan’s forbidden martial arts. In a battle against the Black Flame Sect, he met his death. But when he opened his eyes, he had become Wolbin Dan, the infamous fourth young master of the Dan Clan. Now blessed with a body perfectly suited for the martial arts, he is determined to rewrite the past and prevent the destruction of the Dan C…

Among the numerous emblems to exist, only one is said to be cursed with the fate of ruin—the Emblem of Asura. After a man who serves an unseen will reduces Vahn’s life to ashes and casts him into a timeless abyss, Vahn endures 999 long years of torment before awakening the true power of ruin. Reborn as vengeance incarnate, his retribution begins.

Ji-in Yang is just an average otaku until a boy who looks exactly like her favorite anime character transfers to her class. Mireu Shin is overly friendly from the start, and she eats up the attention, much to the dismay of her longtime friend, Bongjun Choi, who begins expressing his feelings more openly. Even Dongsu Mun, her quiet academy comrade, wants to spend more time with her. To complicate t…

Soyu Yang is better than you and he knows it. Even in his dreams, he is the chosen one. A martial arts grand master, Yukgwan, speaks to him in a dream and brings him into a parallel world with superhuman abilities and “errors,” mutations that turn you into a monster. One of these errors is a former disciple of Yukgwan, now a dragon, and terrorizing the parallel world. Soyu and Kara, hi…

entries.t: My Desire is Not a Sin
entries.d: On their ninth anniversary, Ian receives what seems like a perfect gift, a building in the most coveted part of the city for the expansion of her art gallery. With the steamy night that followed afterward, it was set to become the most romantic anniversary ever… until her husband sneaks out in the middle of the night to cheat on her.

entries.t: My Bias is Obsessed with Me
entries.d: Seha lives for Alexandrite, her favorite character in a dating sim game. When she learns he dies in other routes, the shock sends her into the game itself as Lady Arianell, a minor side character. Determined to save him, she decides to play the villain and force his romance with the heroine. Her plan seems simple until Alexandrite falls for her instead, his flirtatious brother also takes an intere…

"You were the most worthy opponent I had... Farewell, Beatrice."
Sierratica Tiar Yerphinen, my sworn enemy.
I died by his sword... until I didn't?!

Beatrice Shelle Marcean wakes up five years after the day of her death in a new kingdom—a new body, in a new family. She has gone from duchess to princess—and the man from her past, Sierratica Yerphinen, barges into her land to offer a tre…

entries.t: The Second Male Lead is Actually a Girl
entries.d: Rosa remembers her past life. She remembers reading about the Helios Empire in a novel before dying suddenly in an accident. Reborn as Rosa Veronica, she works hard to make ends meet until someone from the Duke of Estella's estate comes to fetch her. Meeting her biological father turns her life upside down as she's forced to live the life of Rozenta Estella, the sole heir and only son of the Duke …

entries.t: I Thought I was the Real Daughter
entries.d:
Selena’s whole world is turned upside down when Sienna, the daughter of a maid, suddenly claims that she’s the real daughter of Count Estarion.
Sienna remembers everything about Selena’s childhood, making everyone believe that she’s the real daughter. Her once supportive brother and father, who are everything to her, turn cold and kick her out of the house. Even her close f…

After a fatal tragedy, our heroine wakes up as an unknown character named Aurora in a novel she has once read. While coming to grips with her new reality, she’s sent to marry the Duke of Ettica, a.k.a. infamous piece of trash. This trash duke knows no bounds!

"Could you punch me right now?" Not only is he a scumbag, but he's a perv too?!

"If I end up falling for you, I will become your loy…

Uhyeon Baek logs into Reverse Planet expecting a VR game, only to discover that the world is painfully real. A decade of grief and experiments turns him into a superhuman contract killer, and he finally executes the director behind his suffering. But when he returns to his original life, the ghosts of his fallen companions follow him. Haunted and restless, he goes back to Reverse Planet, only to r…

Eunseol unexpectedly runs into her high school ex, U-hyeon, after years of separation. Their reunion quickly becomes awkward, but after some drinks, the tension fades, and a drunken kiss leads to a night at a motel. The next morning, Eunseol panics, unable to remember the night. As she tries to move on, she’s confronted by her past when she runs into her ex. Will she overcome the past and re…

Yuya Shirasaki is a weak Awakened with no Natural Skill--a fact that causes his death in Earth’s final apocalyptic monster invasion in 2034. But when he opens his eyes again, he finds himself 10 years in the past and poised to use his knowledge of the future to save Arisa Miyanaga, a similarly weak guildmate. Doing so unlocks his Unique Skill, Akashic Records, which gives him perfect knowled…

entries.t: Star Wars™: Darth Maul - Black, White & Red
entries.d: One of the most famous villains in STAR WARS lore stars in epic tales illustrated in stark black and white — and his own iconic red! When a prison ship — transporting a cult known as the Final Occultation — goes offline, Darth Maul is sent by Palpatine to investigate. What he finds on board is the stuff of nightmares! On another mission to singlehandedly conquer a mining colony, …

Scrappy fencer Nicholas Cox has big dreams of following in the footsteps of the father he’s never known, but when he’s accepted into the elite Kings Row boarding school, he’s thrust into a world of cutthroat competition. Facing down privileged classmates, grueling tryouts, and the stuffy rules of his new school, Nicholas discovers that it will take more than determination to prov…

entries.t: His Recovery Magic Worked Too Well!
entries.d: Neglected and abused for killing her mother in childbirth, Patricia Alben leaves home at an early age to join the army, where she thrives thanks to her exceptional mana. There, she meets Theo, a bastard prince assigned to her unit. Pity turns into closeness as she trains him, until they’re sent on a suicide mission where Patricia is gravely injured saving Theo. Healed by Theo’s magic, …

entries.t: Becoming A Family With The Duke and His Dear Son
entries.d: After being transmigrated as Ibellia the Villainess, Soyoon strives to twist the plot in order to survive in her favorite web novel. Her plan is to break off the engagement with Duke Cassis Adelhardt and live a quiet life on her own. However, the Duke and his young son Lucius would not let her go so easily. “Lady Ibellia... Will you be Lus’ mommy?”

entries.t: The Archmage Becomes the Swordmaster's Youngest Daughter
entries.d: Rosette was a mage and assassin who lived as a mere tool, mistaking control for love, until her choices led her to kill Duke Adrian, the Empire’s legendary swordmaster. Haunted by regret, she uses ancient magic to send herself back in time and fix everything that went wrong. However, although she succeeds in returning to her childhood, she ends up being adopted by the very duke she murdered …

Feared as the Divine Demon, Cheon Jeong lived and died on the battlefield, knowing nothing but violence. When death finally claims him, it should have been the end. Instead, he awakens thirty years later in the body of Mujin Hwa, the powerless heir of a ruined clan. His overwhelming strength is gone, replaced by a frail body and enemies closing in from every side. To protect the siblings now in hi…

After graduating from the Korean National Police University and becoming a detective, Jiyong is assigned to investigate a suspicious report and comes face-to-face with a nationwide jeonse scam. As he confronts criminals who slip through the cracks of the legal system without proper punishment, Jiyong begins to question the rules of vigilante justice he once set for himself. While pursuing the scam…

Hogil Byeon is a third-class killer in the criminal organization Glory Club, with no way up and only one way out. He pivots into law, but his knack for killing doesn’t disappear. Juggling courtrooms and bullets, Hogil starts redefining justice his own way. The law has limits, but Hogil doesn’t. When a lawyer has killer skills, justice is served… with a bang!

A modern-day woman awakens reborn as Athanasia, the doomed princess of a novel she knows by heart, destined to be executed by her own father, Emperor Claude. Determined to survive, she plans to live unnoticed and escape before her fate can unfold. But when she encounters the ruthless emperor years earlier than the story dictates, her careful plans begin to unravel. Trapped inside a narrative that …

After playing the game Guardian of Humanity for years and becoming an expert, Je-u Han finds himself dragged into a new server of the game and forced to play at the weakest level. The problem is, death in the game means death in real life too. As Demon Kings rise and imperial forces collide, even the routes he once mastered twist into unfamiliar danger. Can Je-u break free from the patterns that d…

entries.t: I Woke Up As a Notorious Troublemaker!
entries.d: A burned-out employee of a toxic company falls asleep one day and wakes up as Christina Vonluk, the infamous villainess. Despite her hopes for a quiet, overtime-free life, she quickly learns that Christina’s past crimes have marked her for punishment. Exiled to the Londan estate by royal decree, she’s placed under the watch of Cedric, the gorgeous but socially inept young lord who desp…

College freshman Da-in Kim enters Myeongmun University determined to craft the perfect campus life: top grades, meaningful friendships, and even a handsome boyfriend. However, her plans unravel quickly after meeting her stunningly beautiful namesake, Da-in Kang, and a reserved guy named Su-hyeon Cha. When Su-hyeon publicly rejects her in favor of the “prettier” Da-in, her carefully bui…

Build a powerful house and restore the proud heritage of the vampires! But first, some desserts and shopping!
Anne wakes up from her sleep when Eden, the alchemist of time, removes the spear that had put her in a 200-year slumber. The world has changed greatly during that time. Humans have won the war of the races, made great technological advancements, and created a wonderful thing called ice cre…

entries.t: The Tale of the Skeleton Messenger
entries.d:
120 years have passed since the First Emperor’s death. Venlyra, a powerful rogue and trusted herald of the Emperor, awakens from a long slumber to a crumbling empire that has strayed from the light. Once more, the Skeleton Messenger makes the rounds, bound for a decaying throne, and for the embers of a self long thought extinguished within.
Hear ye, hear ye! Hark, and heed the Emperor’…

Nagi Kujo is a genius surgeon who helps patients in countries affected by armed conflicts. When he finally returns to Japan to treat his adoptive father, the man who saved him and taught him medicine, Nagi learns that his father has been killed—not by accident, but by someone’s design. Determined to uncover the truth, he turns his skills toward a different kind of surgery, cutting deep…

Elias Bai, Captain of God's Legion, stood as the world's strongest Awakener until a brutal betrayal claimed his entire squad. Dying as a mere pawn of the ruling elite, he suddenly wakes up twenty years in the past—back in middle school, long before his awakening. With his loved ones still alive, Elias refuses to let history repeat itself. To save his team, exact vengeance on the traitor, and…

Qin Jing can’t remember when he first realized it, but it seems that everyone who falls for him ends up being targeted by misfortune.

So Qin Jing came up with a plan: by acting cold and cruel when they confessed their feelings, he always managed to push them away and keep them safe from his “curse.” But… why doesn’t this strategy seem to work on the new transfer stu…

entries.t: Don't Mess With My Duke Dubless!
entries.d: Jade is a professional fangirl on a mission. After being reborn into her favorite novel, she's determined to save her tragic bias, Duke Dubless, by finding him a perfect match. But her "expert" knowledge of the plot proves useless when her chaotic matchmaking schemes end in a hilarious disaster, throwing her directly into the arms of the duke himself. He was supposed to fall for a storybook heroin…

Raised to obey, not inherit, Ava “the Screwup” Moretti struggles to claim her place as the youngest child of one of New York’s most powerful mob families. But one steamy night with a stranger gives her a taste of freedom she was never meant to have. When she learns that her one-night stand is Nick Caponelli, heir to her family’s rival, desire threatens to shake the delicate…

From childhood, Artezia Rosan's happiness was dependent on ensuring the success of her brother. As a master manipulator and schemer, she became his most valuable ally in seizing the empire’s throne. That’s exactly why her brother's betrayal cut so deeply when Artezia was imprisoned as punishment for all of her crimes. Soon after being rescued by Grand Duke Cedric Ebron, she vows to hel…

Da-in never expected to reunite with her first love, Seojun, under such bizarre circumstances. Claiming that marriage is the only way to escape his supposed fated death, Seojun proposes a 100-day contract marriage. Refusing to be at a disadvantage, Da-in negotiates her own terms and plunges into an unconventional newlywed life. What starts as a calculated agreement slowly unravels into something d…

entries.t: Reborn As the Character That Never Existed
entries.d: After dying four years ago, a writer who is skilled at making tragic characters was reborn into one of the novels she wrote, but as Thalia Remetio, a character that didn't exist in her story. Thalia is the older sister of Loina Remetio, the female protagonist. Fortunately, Loina and the second male lead will have a decent childhood. However, unfortunately, this is only because they are destined to…

entries.t: The Murdered Princess and the Innocent Traitor
entries.d: When she was discovered as a lost princess, Brigit was overjoyed to be reunited with her older siblings. However, she is ultimately murdered as a sacrificial offering. Before her soul dissolves, she strikes a deal with Nidhor the dragon, who turns back time to when Brigit was yet to be found by her family. Unwilling to attempt revenge, she resolves to flee the empire. However, complications arise …

Being the high priest's powerless illegitimate daughter, Radiana is tricked into becoming a human sacrifice instead of her half-sister. Just when she's about to be burned alive as a tribute to Prince Oratio, the sun god's son, Oratio sees her struggling to survive and takes an interest in her. He then saves her and brings her back to his palace in the divine realm, where he offers to let her live …

entries.t: The Possessive Tyrant and His Sleepy Cat
entries.d: Some people are reborn as the villainess, some people are reborn as the heroine, but after getting hit by a truck, I've been reborn as... a cat? Not only that, but I've reincarnated into a world that sees cats as cursed monsters destined to ruin the empire! But you'll protect me, won't you, Emperor? I'll make you love me--even if it means using every cute cat trick in the book!

Lady Seisia Lidyne is on the run and settles down in a commoner village as Sha, a healer. The villagers are wary of the new face, but if only they knew she also came from a family of dark magicians. Seisia keeps her magical powers hidden, until she encounters a wounded nobleman by the name of Dian, who is in need of her assistance. But after she heals him, the man decides to stick around the villa…

entries.t: Demonic Frontline: The 13th Flying Dragon Company
entries.d: Once an embarrassment to his clan, Jin Seonu starts a new life after being sent to the frontlines, only to be killed years later by his very own brother! But what’s this? He wakes up only to find himself back where he was 10 years earlier? Armed with his knowledge of the future, he returns to the frontlines once again to prove himself for real this time!

entries.t: Caught in the Dark Navy Admiral’s Net
entries.d: Selah Cardi is a former marine biology student who woke up in a romance novel as an inconsequential extra. Eager to survive the plot, Selah manages to rescue Maria so that she and Duke Herbert, her fiancé, will be indebted to her. But then Admiral Ellaim notices her and her magical abilities that allow her to breathe underwater. Selah soon discovers that Ellaim is a merman called a siren, a…

In the glory days of the Republic, two hundred years before the adventures of Luke, Leia, Han, and Chewbacca, the Jedi stand as guardians of galactic peace—until a powerful new adversary called the Nihil arrives.

entries.t: Sea of Thieves: The Last Bite
entries.d: A new crew of rogues have sailed to the pirate paradise known as the Sea of Thieves, but things aren’t right aboard ship. With their captain lost and tempers fraying, one question’s still on everyone’s minds - which of them broke their oath and stole the Last Bite? There’s adventures to be had and treasures to be taken from these untamed shores, but as their bond of trust d…

entries.t: The Swordmaster Who Leapt Through Time
entries.d:
The Kingdom of Vanroah has fallen.
Lansen, the last prince, flees with the remaining survivors to a faraway land. Vowing to one day revive the kingdom, he becomes a swordmaster at a young age, only for a treacherous incident to strip everything away.
Powerless to protect those he loves, he uses an ancient artifact to travel 10,000 years back in time to the Age of the Arcane. There, its rich knowle…

The 12-year-old orphan, Gunhild, lives in a world where humans revere the powerful Asgardians as gods and fear the mystical Jotuns. The fire Jotun Gunhild leaves behind her human village upbringing to embark on a great adventure where she will prove her worth by becoming a god. Gunhild is an award-winning Norse Mythology series by the stellar Fred Tornager, published by Saturday AM.

Every night, a man comes to Seyeon’s dreams, but who is he? Four years after losing five months of her memory, Seyeon is haunted by a faceless man who appears strong, tender, and intoxicatingly passionate. Who is this man who visits her every night? Is he her lost lover? The father of her child? Or just a stranger? How far will she go to uncover the truth?

After thousands watch his messy breakup stream, Simon goes from star streamer to heartbroken social outcast. But everything changes when Rina, a curious runaway android who looks exactly like his favorite VTuber, gives him a brain-rewiring kiss that turns his reality into a living dating sim. Suddenly, Simon is hunted down by lethal agents and assassins seeking to recapture the state-of-the-art bo…

Peony Marshall, a noble-born girl with nothing to her name but the memory of her childhood friend and first love "Zach," prepares for nunhood. Every day, she prays to see Zach one last time... until one day, Zach, whose real identity is King Ernest Edward, finds Peony and takes her away as his imperial concubine. In the palace, Peony realizes how erratic Ernest's behavior is and begins to fear for…

entries.t: My Angelic Husband is actually a Devil in Disguise
entries.c: https://swebtoon-phinf.pstatic.net/20260103_2/1767389433431BxHQx_JPEG/My Angelic Husband is actually a Devil in Disguise_EN_Thumb_Poster.jpg?type=crop540_540
entries.d: Setia only accepts the marriage offer from Miere Lunaira because she needs the money to get out of her family’s debt. But her rich yet dim-witted husband goes missing one month into their marriage, ultimately being presumed dead. Three years later, Setia is shocked to see her “dead” husband has returned as a hero. Although their marriage contract is about to expire, Miere has no …

After being used as a pawn by her selfish family and poisoned by her evil third husband, Ignette wakes up in the past with a chance to redo her life. This time, she's determined to preserve her first marriage to Grand Duke Askalon, who was her only saving grace in her previous life. But in the grand duke's absence, she finds herself drawn to his kind and dashing envoy, Hatz, who helps her adjust t…

entries.t: Can't Go Too Far with the Unrelenting Duke
entries.d: After years of grueling work as a maid, Amelie publishes a hit novel and becomes the youngest professor at the Royal Academy. But she seems less lucky in the romance department when a fortune teller says anyone she marries will die an untimely death. Therefore, Amelie decides to spend a passionate night with a handsome stranger before succumbing to her destiny as a spinster. However, she soon lear…

entries.t: Will My Doting Husband Love Me Again?
entries.d: How do you win over your husband... while in another woman's body? That's precisely the task at hand for Adeline Tiaget - formally known as Charlotte Valerian. When Charlotte's step-father's incessant scheming leads her to be poisoned to death, she is given a chance to live on in the body of the most beautiful woman in the empire. Now, all there's left to do is exact her revenge and make her forme…

Cyclops and Emma Frost re-form the X-Men with the express purpose of "astonishing" the world. But when breaking news regarding the mutant gene unexpectedly hits the airwaves, will it derail their new plans before they even get started? As demand for the "mutant cure" reaches near-riot levels, the X-Men go head-to-head with the enigmatic Ord, with an unexpected ally - and some unexpected adversarie…

Lithera Merto is just another typical female lead transmigrated into a typical novel with a typical life. Unfortunately, her happily every after is anything but standard. Divorced from her supposed male lead and now saddled with the work of a princess and nobles who conspire against her, she takes another chance at happiness by meeting the Duke who she's been exchanging letters with for years.

When the children in a sleepy Wisconsin town begin to go missing, all hope seems lost. Most children never return, and those that do have terrible stories of terrifying creatures that live in the shadows. But even monsters fear the mysterious stranger that arrives shortly after. She believes the children and claims to be the only one who sees what they can see... Her name is Erica Slaughter. She k…

entries.t: A Hero Who Knows His Stuff
entries.d: For 20 years, Hyeonseok fought monsters in another world before finally managing to save it and be sent back to Earth as a reward. Now a former deliveryman named Chanseok, he looks forward to enjoying modern conveniences, only to discover that Earth is very different from what he remembers. Monsters have started appearing from Erosion Points that pop up at random, and people with innate abilities …

One day, I woke up as a noble inside the game I used to play. Unfortunately, the game ends in an apocalypse. With ten years left, I track down the future villains while they’re still kids and decide to raise them myself, hoping that a better childhood could stop them from destroying the world. Now, with criminals dropping like flies, the kingdom thinks I’m the terrifying mastermind pul…

entries.t: The Despised Dark Mage Lives Again
entries.d:
Moments before victory, dark mage Kai Austin is betrayed and loses everything. His death becomes a reset, sending him five years into the past—to the day of the class assignment ceremony—with all of his magic intact. Armed with max-level dark magic and every memory of the future, Kai refuses to let history repeat itself.

This time, he will protect Colette, stop the coming disasters be…

Yeoreum Lee, a university student, unexpectedly reunites with her first love, Suyeong Ji, and his fiancée, Han-gyeong Bae, the owner of the café where she works. Their relationship began in high school when Yeoreum's mother worked as a housekeeper at Suyeong's family home. After years of heartbreak, they meet again, but this time, Suyeong unknowingly drinks a potion that makes him fa…

Sol, a college student, returns home for the first time in three years, only to find her mother Mi-ae living with a young guy named Romi Oh. At first, she thinks he’s Mi-ae’s boyfriend, but it turns out they’re just housemates.
Sol somehow ends up living with them, although she doesn’t like Romi at all. She believes he’s too brazen and carefree. However, in time, she …

Witness the corruption of reason and divinity. Escape the nine hells of Fog Land.
Driven by his conviction that everyone deserves education, science teacher Dante Kang agrees to teach in Fog Land, a mysterious international prison that houses the world’s most notorious criminals. But his very first class gets interrupted by a violent prison riot, after which, he finds himself in the cell of …

Olivia Liberty is the first commoner ever admitted to Herolington University. However, she cannot be properly recognized because she is a woman and must instead use the name of a man, Oliver, to receive credit for her creations.
Meanwhile, Noah Astrid, Prince of Herod, takes notice of Olivia, who is beloved by the commoners of Herod. Noah seeks to involve her in royal affairs to raise the royal fa…

entries.t: The Grand Duke’s Bride is a Warrior from Hell
entries.d: Alicia Sirius Rayne, a timid, stuttering spinster betrothed to the rumored "Grand Duchess Serial Killer," falls into Hell after opening a mysterious artifact. Now, she must adapt to survive. Years later, she has become a fierce warrior. But as she sets out to conquer all of Hell -- she wakes up in the past. Armed with a second chance at life and a new goal, Alicia must actively pursue the feared G…

After Ihan Jeong’s mother and brother died in a car crash when she was just 9 years old, she was raised by Chio Han and his parents, who lived next door. Now about to attend university, Ihan suddenly finds herself living with Chio under one roof, and she realizes that she feels more than just familial affection for her brother figure. While trying to deal with her trauma and the awkwardness …

Wolverine, Deadpool, Doctor Doom, Thanos: There's one hero that's beaten them all-and now she's got her own ongoing series! (Not that she's bragging.) That's right, you asked for it, you got it, it's SQUIRREL GIRL! (She's also starting college this semester.) It's the start of a brand-new set of adventures starring the nuttiest and most upbeat super hero in the world!

In a world where magical heritage is punishable by death, a young boy named Wynd must hide his true identity — and pointy ears — from everyone in Pipetown, even if it means he’ll never have the normal life he wants. With nothing but his powers and his best friends by his side, Wynd goes on a dangerous journey, uncovering the truth about his mysterious heritage and navigating the …

While fleeing the Galactic Federation, Stitch's spaceship malfunctions and he makes an emergency landing... not in Hawaii, but in sengoku-era Japan! Discovered by the hard-hearted warlord Lord Yamato and his clan, Stitch's incomparable cuteness is no match for the battle-weary samurai, who decides to bring the "blue tanuki" home with him. Will Stitch's love of chaos turn into a formidable advantag…

After the fall of the Kingdom of Jarthewer, Princess Lisselotte and her maid, Hannah, escape to the Grand Duchy of Ralus, home of the princess’s fiancé, Vincent Ralus. Though Hannah has lost her memory after nearly drowning, she stays strong, enduring Lady Charlotte’s daily abuse in hopes of a better future. 
But everything changes when Vincent asks her to pose as Princess Lisse…

Jihun, once part of an elite secret special forces unit, returns from overseas duty to the devastating news of his sister Jiyun’s death. Her boyfriend Minjun is blamed, but Jihun soon learns Minjun entered Yeokseon Prison under a false charge to uncover the real killer. When Minjun is found dead inside the prison, Jihun refuses to accept the official story. Taking on the role of a correction…

entries.t: How is This Hot Duke Just a Background Character?!
entries.d: After reincarnating as Leticia, a minor extra in an otome game, the “new” Leticia unexpectedly inherits her twin sister’s engagement to Lionel, a rumored chubby and awkward duke-to-be. But Leticia sees the potential beneath his rough edges and takes it upon herself to help him grow. As Lionel transforms into a refined and handsome noble, his feelings for her deepen rapidly. Thoug…

entries.t: Some Day You Will Give Birth To Me
entries.d: Born to a sorceress and a prince of the Holy Empire, Evanna is forced to ascend the throne in a world that shuns magic. Though she works hard to pray her powers away, Evanna is despised by all. Her only hope through abuse and isolation comes with the discovery of her mother’s grimoire. The magic within sends Evanna back in time, to before her parents met. Her goal: to guide them to a better …

The path to greatness begins… tomorrow!
It’s always a day too early for a great procrastinator like Yeonho Wi to start training. So how did someone as lazy as him become a great warrior renowned for his virtue, benevolence, and might? Follow the historian’s journey to uncover the hidden secrets of the lazy master of martial arts.

Maria Lwelin reawakens in the Larson Empire with the power to communicate with animals. Upon learning that the crown prince is willing to grant one wish to the vet who can heal his pet panther, she jumps at the chance for an exciting new adventure!

entries.t: The Genius Midfielder with the Killer Pass
entries.d: 17-year-old Yujun Song lives for soccer. However, when he suddenly becomes color-blind, he has no choice but to walk away from his dream. 15 years later, after a car crash, Yujin finds himself on the brink of death and makes one last wish: to step onto the soccer field one more time.
