In the next moment, he appears to have been given this chance as he finds himself back in his 17-year-old body. On …

The world is destroyed by a demon invasion and Bigang Sa is forced to serve in the demon army for centuries. After a failed human uprising, Bigang transports himself back into his body, ten years before the arrival of the demons. Can he use his centuries of demon warrior training to create a new class of murim fighters powerful enough to ward off the coming invasion?

entries.t: Finding a Ticket Into Your Heart
entries.d: After a brutal breakup, Yubyeol flies to Spain alone where one wild, blurry night with a stranger named Seonu changes everything. Back in Korea, fate brings them together again… but this time, they only have 90 days before Seonu must return to Spain. Between unresolved heartbreak, unexpected chemistry, and a deadline she never asked for, can Seonu find his ticket into Yubyeol’s heart …

a: Lucasfilm Ltd., Claudia Gray, Yusaku Komiyama
entries.d:
Seduced by the Galactic Empire's promises of unity and change, the planets of the galaxy and the hearts of their people fall under the Emperor's control one by one... 

Sharing a love of ships and an admiration for the Empire, childhood friends Thane Kyrell and Ciene Ree enroll in the Imperial Academy in hopes of realizing their dreams of joining the fleet. The more they learn, however, the more t…

A young, bumbling countryside girl called Asa dreams of travelling the land of Tengriya to master her powers and become a Nomad. She can't help but fall head first from one problem into the next, into meeting new friends and foes alike, onwards unto a world she knows less than she knows herself. Because that is the Nomad way!

Ilea Spears wanted a fight, not a life behind a desk. So when this boxer-turned-med student wakes up in Elos -- a dangerous fantasy world where combat is a daily requirement -- she’s more than a little thrilled. 

There, she unlocks the long-lost Battle Healer class, an unusual blend of combat strength and healing magic, and discovers she may have finally found her calling. 

As she travels …

entries.t: Star Wars™: Darth Vader - Black, White, & Red
entries.d:
One of the most iconic villains of all time, Darth Vader, gets his own entry in Marvel’s smash hit monochrome anthology!

Exciting tales from a galaxy of talents featuring the Dark Lord of the Sith! Jason Aaron returns to the world of Star Wars, teaming with artist Leonard Kirk to present a new tale of terror! Peach Momoko spins a story in her signature style! Daniel Warren Johnson brings Va…

With her family, staff, and title being threatened after her year-long exile, Grace must now use her wits and strength to protect herself against her two-faced stepmother, half-sister, and father who have turned against her.

The demons took his farmhouse, his wife, his peace. Now Vincent Burns lives to kill as many as he can. The excommunicated exorcist, along with Sister Beatrice and local sheriff Chloe, has found himself in the middle of a demonic plot to bring Hell itself to the United States, yet the biggest puzzle is the white-haired girl he found in a suitcase. Demons not only die upon biting her; flowers bloom …

The legendary con artist in the pleasure city of Ardel, Sue Rolanne, is hired by an aloof duke to pull off the ultimate grift: deceive the king. To infiltrate high society, the pair stage a sham marriage and what began as a “contract couple” turns into a high-stakes, kingdom-wide con.

From her first day as a maid in the Yufgenschult Estate, Dahlia Belohr is repeatedly warned to not go near the annex where a "ghost" is rumored to live. However, one day, she is forced to go to the annex to deliver a parcel and sees the famed ghost herself. Contrary to the rumors, the ghost is neither hideous nor violent but is handsome and kind enough to gift her books. Interestingly, it seems li…

Lenny, a young French student, arrives in Montreal to pursue his journalism studies. As part of a class assignment, he meets Anoki, a quiet Algonquin student, and the two are paired up as a team. Their investigation soon draws them into a mysterious monster hunt. Caught between myths and legends and possible deception, the two boys challenge each other’s beliefs and gradually form a deep bon…

A good girl. An obedient daughter. A submissive wife.
Scarlett spent her entire life being the prized doll on the shelf; first for her father, and now for a cruel duke who is to be her husband. Tired of the belittling and manipulation, Scarlett finally decides to take matters into her own hands and fight for a life of freedom. And that's the thing about girls who've been forced to be quiet their w…

entries.t: If You So Desire My Despair
entries.d: Orphaned at a young age and drowning in her father’s debt, Anastasia spends her days as a starving noble. That is, until her uncle offers her a way out by getting her engaged to his enemy, Duke Theodore Redford. Upon moving in with her fiancé, Anastasia has to endure all sorts of mistreatment from the cruel duke and his servants. But her lonely and depressing life takes a turn when sh…

To Blanche, everything seemed hopeless. Until she realized it was all a game. One she made, to be exact. Now she has a goal: Become the villain's right-hand man! But wait. Why is she the one saving him...?
Blanche, who is timid and kind but is despised by her family, cannot overcome her family's contempt and attempts suicide.
After that, when I opened my eyes, this world was the game world I made!…

Lara and Suni are childhood friends who meet again after 10 years. Suni is a member of the world’s most successful idol group, "THE GLASS''. Lara is looking for a job while planning her wedding with her fiancé, Mark. After a small accident, they meet again and - thanks to Suni's help - Lara gets a job as her new manager! However, Suni has a secret… she’s been in love with…

entries.t: The Northern Duke Needs a Warm Hug
entries.d: When the talented imperial wizard Nisha makes an unconventional deal with King Frei, she goes on a mission to lift the curse of the Grand Duke of the North, Lanfel Delore! Turns out that the dark and handsome Duke Lanfel isn't as strong as he appears to be, and it seems like the freezing gray days of winter is a bit too much for the Duke's frail body. While Nisha does her research around the Duke'…

Sasha is the cunning villainess in the novel ""War Wagon of Fire"" who uses the evil sons of the Serpente Family to plunge the Xerkesia Empire into chaos. But when the reader wakes up as a younger version of Sasha who's trapped in a hidden corner of the Serpente manor with the Serpente children, she's baffled because this was never mentioned in the novel. The children's uncle claims it's only for …

Jeonghwan, once a legendary mercenary, returns under an identity no one expected— a prosecutor. His mission is to uncover the truth behind his mother’s mysterious death, the tragedy that robbed him of his peace and future. To take his revenge, Jeonghwan must wield two weapons: violence for those who stand in his way, and the law for those who must be judged.

Mouse was just a regular college student when her legs suddenly started to go numb. At first, she brushed it off, thinking it was nothing. But as the symptoms worsened and even walking became painful, a visit to the hospital revealed something she never expected. What do you do when your body begins to betray you, and nothing feels certain anymore?

Online, Yuni is a glamorous influencer. In reality, she lives in poverty with her timid, overworked mother, Deulre. After a horrific family tragedy leaves Yuni orphaned, she’s suddenly thrust back in time and finds her mother a teenager again.
Determined to rewrite the future, Yuni enrolls in her mother's high school to protect her teen mom from her toxic friends and the choices that led to …

In the quiet village of Feltham, Eloise Surbiton leads a peaceful life far from the hubbub of the city, tending to geese and secretly fawning over dashing war hero Lt. Col. Ryan Wilgrave from afar. When her father mentions that a certain military man named Ryan will be moving to the nearby town of Cambourne, Eloise is thrilled — only to have her hopes dashed when she meets her new neighbor R…

“There are plenty of fish in the sea,” or so they say. Easier said than done for Gahi Kim, whose crush is rising K-drama star Yubin Choi. Despite going to the same university as Yubin, Gahi can only daydream and grumble to her bestie and roommate Sara, as there’s never any sign of her crush on campus. But then, while having drinks at a nearby pub, Gahi meets a boy who’s the…

entries.t: The Back Alley Mage's Second Life
entries.d: Once a loyal hound to a powerful magic family, Aster was used, betrayed, and killed. But death wasn’t the end—it was a second chance. Back in the back alleys of his youth, Aster now holds the future’s secrets in his hands. This time, he won’t serve anyone. Can a man who once served power learn to become his own master?

Seo-joon used to be the unluckiest man in the universe, until one final disastrous twist of fate led to his death. Reincarnated as a Black Mage, he discovers a special ability called Ultimate Karma, turning him into the luckiest being in existence. Determined to find a way back to Earth and reunite with his mother, he embarks on an epic quest where he must face power struggles, lost loves, and sho…

entries.t: The Max Magic Level Great Sage’s Return
entries.d: In 1970, “The Great Sage,” Minato Ichikami, saved the world by destroying the invading “Demon God” and its forces. After this intense battle, Minato Ichikami died. After 50 years, he wakes up in a teenager’s body by the name of Minato Kusanagi! Now, the year is 2022, and our hero is inside a student’s body. What’s more, 50 years of peace has weakened magic…

Jihun is pulled into Knight Defense, a game where he must lead the kingdom’s knights against endless waves of monsters. Weighed down by the scars of his real life, Jihun chooses not to fight and turns his back on humanity. But as soon as he does, the system unveils a new path: the Monster Faction.
Defense is over. It’s now time for offense.

Beauty was her curse. What others envied and longed for only brought her misery. Scarred and weary, I-yeon decided to hide her crafted-by-god looks. 
In doing so, she gained a new identity, the ugly secretary, I-yeon Yu. She endured the mockery and lived quietly in the shadows until one day...
"Let's live together."
Do-hyeon An, the only heir of the powerful Wooseung Group, suddenly proposed to he…

After surviving a brutal childhood tragedy and awakening from a mysterious coma, Shinyeok Lee returns with the mind of a genius profiler and fifteen years’ worth of knowledge that no one can explain. Now, he reads the lies of the living and uncovers the truths of the dead, solving crimes no one else can. But every case brings him closer to the murderer who destroyed his family. Can Shinhyeok…

World War III has ended, but Jimin’s troubles are only beginning. A superhuman bloomer, he’s enslaved in a scrapyard, where his life changes after he finds and repairs Aurora, a discarded battle bot. Post-war exploitation of the weak and clashing factions has given rise to the Second Lost Generation. Even if they escape, they’ll still have to grow up in the chaos. But can they ou…

Mia was Taesu's first love, who suddenly disappeared one day. After five years of silence, she reappears as a freshman at his university. But she's not the girl he remembers. He plays it cool, trying to ignore her, but can first love truly be forgotten? Or will fate give them a second chance?

Nina the cat lost the Zodiac Race by one spot, and she's held a grudge for millennia. When she forces a divine do-over, unlucky student Cosmo Lee becomes the reluctant referee. His mission? Gather twelve Zodiac Spirits for the ultimate competition. The catch? They've all possessed girls from his school. Can an ordinary boy survive refereeing an extraordinary battle between Heaven-sent superpowered…

Princess Roxiana of Cantar seems destined for a life of happiness as she departs to wed her childhood fiancé, Prince Lucas. But when her carriage is ambushed by mysterious assailants, Roxiana finds she’s been betrayed. Branded a slave and stripped of her royal title, all hope appears lost…Until she is rescued by Grand Duke Floyd Lathean of Torcan. Roxiana must contend with dang…

Watch as Cassidy, a bubbly, outgoing cheerleader, and Valerie, a book-smart, rather uptight introvert, find common ground in their shared interests and personalities as they go beyond surface-level differences!

Genesis weapons—Heroes of the war, or dangerous threats?
In Tristan, humans and mechanical lifeforms called “cobas” live side by side. Three years ago, the war finally ended, brought down by the Genesis Weapons.
Ode, once a Genesis Weapon himself, investigates the secrets of the M3 company, seeking memories of his life before becoming a weapon. When he discovers children being us…

Have you ever pretended you were good at sports to impress your crush? Enter high school student Haemin Oh, who desperately wants to catch the attention of Ina Jeong, recently elected president of the school swimming club. Ina is recruiting, and despite barely knowing how to float, Haemin somehow ends up making her think that he’s an expert at the sport. Before long, Haemin has to prove hims…

Seol-a’s boyfriend dumps her over text for a woman with better standing, and now they’re getting married. Seung-hu Ji, the CEO, witnesses Seol-a berating her ex for it, but to her surprise, he reacts by taking her out to dinner after. After a drunken night in bed, she finds out she was his first, but could he be her last? Seol-a must now manage dating her company’s CEO and the bl…

“Ah, so it’s you. The one that’s taken my place.”
Still keeping their true identities secret, Sooha and Heli return to school as an official couple when suddenly a mysterious girl with Sooha's face named Selen appears.
Sooha, with whom they have made countless memories together in the current, and Selen, with whom they share deep and fond memories from the past.
As two peop…

entries.t: The Knight of the Sightless Sky
entries.d:
A consuming fire, a dead king, and a family in ruin. 

Ten years after witnessing her mother’s murder, a vengeful maiden returns to the palace as a deadly assassin. But her revenge plot shatters when she discovers an unlikely truth that makes her blade waver. 

Caught between the eyes of silver and violet, the barbed rose must decide... follow the treacherous path of vengeance or uncover the…

entries.t: The Return of the Disaster-Class Hero
entries.d: Twenty years. For twenty long years, the thirteenth saint Lee Geon was trapped inside the Tower of Demons after being backstabbed by twelve of his allies. These twelve "saints" were warriors chosen by the twelve zodiac gods to defeat mysterious monsters called "calamities" that were massacring the planet. Though no god had chosen Geon as a saint, he became the mightiest of them all, which made him…

Minseok loses his daughter again and again in a world overrun by zombies. He’s been mysteriously given 100 lives to save her and has watched her die in 99 of them. On his final one, he dies before they even make it out the front door–except this time, he wakes as a zombie. But a zombie papa still has a father’s heart. Now stronger than ever, he’s ready to take on the world …

When portals called “gates” opened in 1997, humanity was thrown into chaos as monsters ravaged the planet. Countless lives were lost, including Eunha Cha’s mother. Left to fend for herself, Eunha one day mysteriously awakens a new power. Drafted into the military to fight alongside other Hunters, she sets out on what was supposed to be a routine mission inside a C-rank gate. But …

entries.t: Born to be the Grand Duchess
entries.d: Annette Fraise was supposed to die as the novel’s wicked villainess. Instead, she’s using her 21st-century charm to survive her marriage to the cursed Grand Duke of the North, Loic Blenheim. Between one awkward accident, a magical curse, and a one-year marriage contract, love might just become the plot twist that changes everything.

Dana, a Korean high school senior just days away from her college entrance exam, meets an unlucky end. Hit by the infamous "romance fantasy truck" and reborn in another world, she figures she might as well make the best out of it, but she suddenly stumbles across the Saintess's secret! "I don't want to die, so I guess I'll keep the cat in the bag, Saintess!"

entries.t: The Top Assassin in Another World
entries.d: Kai Shinjo, an ordinary high school student by day and a deadly assassin by night, hides behind his quiet, dark demeanor, making him an outcast among his classmates. One day, his entire class is transported to another world — a realm of swords and magic. There, a woman named Leonora reveals they were summoned as Hero candidates to defeat the Demon Lord. Each student receives a Blessing, but …

Reborn with memories she never asked for, Jian Song wants nothing more than a quiet, ordinary life. But everything changes when she meets him again—the man she once loved beyond reason, and the one who shattered her. No matter how hard she tries to stay away, fate keeps pulling them together in ways she never expected. As her new life begins to mirror the tragic patterns of her past, she mus…

Hunt. Kill. Repeat. In the near future, a young girl sees her family slaughtered by the deadliest and most feared hunter in the universe: a Predator. Years later, though her ship is barely holding together and food is running short, Theta won't stop stalking the spaceways until the Yautja monster who killed her family is dead - or she is. And when she crash-lands on a tundra planet, her odds of su…

Protected his entire life by his loyal butler, Sejin, young heir Lee Haneul is discovering the real world for the very first time. As he tastes freedom, friendship, and first love, long-buried secrets begin to resurface.
Why does Sejin seem to care for him as much as he watches over him? The discovery of a terrible secret about his birth will fundamentally change Haneul’s view of the world&m…

An orphan, Sherl Wathson, leaves her job in London to work at the Taylor Mansion.
Rumors and a cloud of mystery surrounds the mansion as strange occurrences keep popping up.
Will Sherl and the other maids be able to get out alive or were they all doomed to begin with?

After being stuck in a loveless marriage and dying in misery, Bianca d’Arno wakes up at 18 with a chance to start all over again. Determined to rewrite her fate, she vows to turn her previously distant husband into an ally instead of an enemy. But in a world where marriage is currency, can she build love out of a transaction, or will history repeat itself?

Wuseong Dan, the man who ruled over the martial world with his fists alone. After unexpectedly losing a duel against two practitioners of the Demonic Way, he’s reborn into the body of the wild child heir apparent of the affluent Silver River Merchants. Not one to leave debts unpaid, be they to his benefit or detriment, Wuseong sets out on his path of revenge in the body of Jineon Lee. Using …

Dakyung Lee, an elite member of a criminal organization, learns of the death of her beloved boss. Upon discovering that Chairman Lee was behind it, she vows to take revenge. Yet, since he’s protected by the Sa Yeong Group, all her attempts appear futile. Just as Dakyung is about to give up, she uncovers details about the chairman’s son. In a final bid for revenge, she infiltrates his s…

Sanho suddenly finds herself as the academy’s only commoner after her school transforms into the world of a romance fantasy novel. Armed with memories of reality, she’s thrown into chaos when a strange mission appears: win over three potential male leads and uncover the truth behind this altered world. Amid dazzling nobles and hidden dangers, can Sanho complete her mission and face the…

Reincarnated as a green-eyed brunette in the novel "The Murderer Targets Brunettes",  Selenia knows that the murderer in question will be arrested within a year. To avoid being murdered herself, she holes herself up in her room until her adoptive father betrays her and has her sent to the mage tower. To her surprise, the master of the tower is Eon de Grandnoir, the very murderer she's trying to av…

Ho Kim, an avid enjoyer of the RPG "Dragon Slayer Academy", is the single most powerful support in the game. 
After spending countless hours, he eventually manages to reach the major milestone of raising 1,000 heroes to S-rank and is presented with a hidden quest.
Tempted by the possibility of raising his S-rank heroes to the more powerful EX-rank, he accepts the quest without a second thought, on…

entries.t: Warrior Grandpa and His Supreme Granddaughter
entries.d:
A fallen clan, a lone survivor, and a warrior grandfather.
Jinsan Yu, once a legendary martial artist, swears to the heavens he would survive until Seol, a child with an extraordinary gift, comes of age.
Through fate’s hand, they encounter allies and enemies alike from the unlikeliest of places, and unearth deep conspiracies concerning the Yu Clan’s downfall.
“I’ll protect …

Nayoung, a newlywed bride, looks forward to welcoming her husband back home after working overnight as a police detective. But she comes home only to learn he had been murdered.
Unable to trust the police, she takes matters into her own hands to uncover the truth.
Too bad for them, though. Nayoung turns out to be a former North Korean spy and notorious elite assassin known to intelligence agencies…

entries.t: Where the Golden Rose was Plucked
entries.d: Every rose has its thorn – even one so fair and bright as Karen Shanaire, a star ballerina in the Empire of Gloretta. Karen, who is secretly a spy for the enemy state of Qustia, must extract valuable intelligence from her latest target, Glorettan war hero and key arms manufacturer Duke Arcturus Kloen. Arcturus begins a relationship of convenience with Karen to ward off scandal, unaware that …

Fernan Fallenberg, heir to the Empire’s most prestigious household and a prodigy of the Imperial Academy, was infamous for valuing everything by money and keeping others at a distance. One day, he is struck by lightning, and a foreign presence tries to invade his mind. Resisting with force, he instead witnesses the Book of Prophecies reveal itself—foretelling the world’s end.

Choose your player: a noble hero intent on saving the world, or a devious demon prince hell-bent on conquering it? A normal choice when playing a new game, but when gaming nerd In-gong Ju wakes up inside the VR game Knight Saga:RE, he finds himself playing as Siutra, a tiny, gnome-like ninth prince of the demon kingdom. In-gong must work quickly to unlock a range of potentially overpowered skills …

26-year old Hansol's finally got a place of his own! But on moving day, he opens the door to find an unexpected roommate: a little white griffin. Where did it come from? Is it lost? But just look at those fluffy bird paws and cute kitty toe beans! Maybe he can stay, just for a while!

Makito Shindo, son of a powerful hospital director, dreamed of saving lives. But after his father’s sudden death, he discovers that he had many enemies simply because of his lineage. Betrayed by a fellow doctor, ruined professionally and financially, and forced into hiding, Makito’s life ends in a tragedy... until a mysterious “Game Over” message gives him a second chance. …

entries.t: The S-Class Hunter’s Peaceful Life with Monsters
entries.d: Chimera hunter Number 17 has spent decades hunting monsters. On his latest mission, he’s ordered to ensure the human hunters’ escape and never return to base. In other words, he’s meant to die. As his body dissolves, his life flashes before him: kidnapped as a boy, forced into endless battles, reduced to a mindless weapon. But against all odds, his body reforms into his human for…

After her sister turns up dead as the latest bride of a monstrous, exiled prince, Louanne is assigned to take her place and hopes to uncover the truth. The prince initially refuses her, but with her magical powers, she begins to heal his pain each night while concealing her own. Meanwhile, her evil uncle, who took advantage of her ability in order to run a medical scheme at home, begins to crumble…

Nayun, a college freshman, only approached the drummer of the campus band 3DAYS to help her best friend get closer to him. But when the band’s handsome vocalist, Seolu, unexpectedly confesses to her that same night, Nayun’s simple plan takes a surprising turn. Convinced that she’s not ready for a relationship, she tells Seolu she’s not looking to date anyone, though her rac…

After a painful breakup with her first love, Eunpyeong returns to campus still haunted by the past and burdened by a secret fantasy she’s afraid to reveal. When Nyeok, a younger guy, discovers her secret by chance, he responds with unexpected acceptance. Their bond deepens, but complications arise when another girl enters the picture, and Eunpyeong learns Nyeok has been denying their relatio…

Euna is half human, half boar and is looked down upon by the others in her village for her weaker boar side. When a tiger attacks the village, Euna fends him off, but is isolated with him in the process. Unfortunately, she falls off the cliff with the tiger as well. The tiger transforms into a human to save her, taking several bashes to the head in the process.

When they find themselves at the bo…

Princess Penelope is just trying to win the family crown when she accidentally trashes the fandom of famous masked actor, Allan Reinhart, live on camera. The problem? She’s secretly his biggest fan! Luckily, her new charismatic bodyguard offers to help rehabilitate her image for the public. But why does Penelope’s savior seem to be hiding a secret of his own?

Dropping out of college was an easy decision for April McKenzie, so long as she could pursue her dreams of becoming a singer. One of her more difficult decisions was to sacrifice her struggling soloist career to join two free-spirited guitarists in an indie band. As they navigate their hopes and dreams together, they find that the music industry is tough, but relationships are even tougher.

Childhood friendships can survive anything... except growing up. 

When a wedding invitation pulls the boys back home, the years between them fade faster than expected. Somewhere between old jokes, remembering and pretending not to, the lines between friendship and something more start to blur... again.

Turns out distance doesn't kill feelings. It just gives them time to get complicated.

Daughter of a noble house, Aria Bellerose, has big dreams of following in her family's footsteps as warriors and generals. But when a marriage proposal between her and the crowned prince Anthony is forced on her by the emperor, she'll have to find a way to outmaneuver his machinations and secure her independence. This puts her in direct competition with her athletic rival Zeke for the only positio…

The quiet war between the forest fairies and humans has been going on for ages. To fight deforestation, fairies are trained into pixies who target potentially threatening individuals who contribute to the issue they face. Naymith is different, however, more sensitive than the other pixies, she has always been doubted to not have the killer instinct it takes.
A fae’s exile and an artist’s despair ignite a journey of magic, danger, and a love that crosses realms.

entries.t: A Single Dad in Another World
entries.d: His wife has gone missing. His baby daughter is terminally ill. But as Junhu falls to his death, he wakes up in his wife’s unfinished dark fantasy novel--a world infested with vile demons. Armed with knowledge of the story, he allies with powerful demon hunters to avert the tragedies to come. Yet every action rewrites the story in unpredictable ways, and Junhu must seek answers if he hopes t…

entries.t: The Grim Reaper is My Guardian
entries.d: Okji Mun can’t escape bad luck. From tripping in class to near-miss accidents, her life has always been one streak of misfortune after another. What she doesn’t realize is that her best friend, Haseong Ji, is actually a Grim Reaper assigned to keep her safe. When the truth comes out, Okji learns her fate has changed and she has only 30 days left to live. A strange method might let her …

When Hyeonu moves into Terrarium Apartments, the place seems idyllic—until he witnesses a man plunge from the building across his window. The residents dismiss the victim as a “misfit”, and Hyeonu soon notices their unsettling, scripted routines. Beneath the cheerful facade lies something far darker: a community that demands conformity and punishes defiance. As the walls close in…

To Yoonha, a model student at an elite high school, romance has always felt like a frivolous distraction. But when four surprising choices for love appear, her pencil begins to waver. Will she choose the right answer and ace the ultimate test?

All things in this world have a price. But what if people did too? With the mysterious "Social Coin" app appearing on phones all over the world, people are now "priced" according to their reputation and character. While those worth high prices thrive, those worth low prices are in danger of facing ostracization, discrimination, or even death.

The world falls into a state of panic when 120 million players of a popular VR game, Eternal World, vanish without a trace one day. A few months later, they begin returning one by one after dying in the game. But they’re not the only ones to make it back—monsters also start to appear and wreak havoc on Earth. All hope seems lost until the Masked Monarch, the most powerful player of Ete…

It all begins with a meteor shower.
Soon after, reports spread of so-called Immortals. Each time they die, their bodies reset to an earlier point in time, with every wound, scar, and even the smallest scratch gone. Humanity is thrown into chaos, unable to explain the strange phenomenon. Two hundred years later, scientists still haven't been able to uncover the mystery of immortality. The Immortals…

Falsely accused of consorting with Demons and executed by the one he trusted most, he wakes up twenty years earlier. In a world ruled by lightning-wielding Nobles, Isaac Quincy— a low-born rebel turned aristocrat—gets a second chance at life. Armed with memories of a ruined future and lightning in his veins, he plans to dismantle the corrupt monarchy responsible for his downfall. But f…

Where does one find the top shamans and the most reliable fortune tellers in the country? Welcome to the stock exchange, where one prediction could make or break billions. This is their all-star match, world series, medal of arts, and olympics all rolled into one. Follow the story of Jiseung Cheon, as he breaks into the world of occult and finance, one shamanic ritual at a time.

Yeoreum is just a normal high school girl determined to find a cute boyfriend. But everything changes when she stumbles across a constellation shard and transforms into one of the Quprids -- warriors with magical powers. How is she supposed to date Gowon, the hottest boy at school, on top of protecting the galaxy? And why does her childhood friend Doyun seem to know more about the shards than he s…

Sujeong writes romance novels but has never lived one. A proud homebody and a self-proclaimed loner, she's content on her own—until the sly and irresistible Seunghyeon crashes into her life and turns it upside down. His charm feels dangerous, yet impossible to resist. Now Sujeong must find out: is he the love that she's been waiting for... or the heartbreak she never saw coming?

When Sahui’s quiet life at Yeonghwadang, a secluded shaman house where she spent her whole life, is disrupted by imposing CEO Tae-eon Jeong, she wants nothing more than to keep her distance. Scarred by abandonment and a childhood accident, she has no interest in love. Yet Tae-eon’s arrogance, charm, and relentless attention begin to break through her defenses, stirring emotions she tho…

Is infinite regression a blessing– or a curse? For Eunhyeon, it is a fate that he desperately wishes to escape.
Seven beings fall into the world of cultivators. Each has rare talents, but Eunhyeon appears to have none and struggles to survive in this strange world. Yet after his death, he finds himself back at the start of it all, realizing that his talent is the ability of infinite regressi…

entries.t: The Stand-in Daughter Wants to Be Free
entries.d: Nina Lindra is a gifted student and skilled magic user, but she has a secret that no one can find out. She often disguises herself as her adoptive sister, Lilia Lust, even taking her exams in her place, at the request of the Lust family. When the kingdom’s queen requests Lilia to heal her ailing son, Nina once again steps into her role, using her powers to ease Prince Erland’s pain. As…

After a prophetic dream foretells her sister’s death in a political marriage, Arasilla Hugo takes matters into her own hands and marries in her place. Her groom? Demian Vandermeer, the knights’ captain and the brother of her sister’s former betrothed. The only problem is that mages and knights are sworn enemies, and their sharp tongues and stubborn hearts turn every situation int…

entries.t: They All Live in the Little Lady's Garden
entries.d: Evelia is reborn with the Spirit King’s seal, a rare mark that makes spirits obey her every command. All she wants is a quiet and ordinary life, but instead she’s spoiled from all sides: doting parents, overprotective brothers, knights begging to guard her, a childhood prince promising an empire, and a charming demon declaring she’s his only desire. Surrounded by devotion, affect…

Da-eun Jeong and Jong-u Yun are the sole known survivors of two killing rampages perpetrated by a mysterious gang. Many years later, an investigation into a possible copycat crime forces them to revisit their trauma.
Da-eun becomes determined once again to find her boyfriend, Gyuheon Shim, who went missing after the murders they witnessed. Meanwhile, Jong-u is plagued by the ghost of “Room 2…

One day, Hyeonjun, the president of an entertainment company, coincidentally sees Yeona on the subway. Mesmerized by her mystical beauty, he begins riding the subway every day, just so he can see her. When they are unexpectedly reunited, love sparks between their hearts... Until Hyeonjun discovers a secret about her.

An epidemic of loneliness, shut-ins and social isolation has swept the entire world, primarily affecting young men. With internet addiction, romantic rejection, and other forms of self-imposed social isolation deemed as medical conditions, corporations eventually sought out a solution inspired by online forums of the afflicted: genetically engineered super companions, or "cat girls."

For Olivia Madeleine, illegitimate daughter of a duke, her only hope of a better life away from her cold-hearted family is her betrothal to arrogant crown prince Leoford Franz. When the revelation of his tryst with another debutante comes as an unsurprising wake-up call, she has no choice but to barter for her freedom with Edwin Lowell Vikander, the ruthless, war-hardened Grand Duke of the north. …

Byeolha Kim was happily married… until she wasn’t anymore. Betrayed by her best friend, she is no longer the bubbly, innocent girl she used to be. However, everything changes once again in an accident that causes her to reality-shift. Now she is stuck in a mysterious but familiar world, and it doesn’t help that her back-stabbing, husband-stealing ex-friend is there with her. Wil…

One dive shattered To-il’s future. Once a rising star on the 10-meter platform, a brutal fall forced him into eighteen months of recovery. Now he returns to the pool, where rivals have surged ahead and every leap carries the shadow of his past. Along the way, he discovers teammates who lift him up, rivals who test his limits, and the fragile but unyielding hope of youth. In the air, seconds …

entries.t: Noble in Name, Vulgar at Heart
entries.d:
Ariana, born into a politically arranged marriage, was nothing more than a tool, used and abused by her family her entire life. On her 28th birthday, she was tragically killed, yearning for a love that never came. Perhaps out of pity, a mysterious force sent her back to when she was 16.
Reflecting on her painful past, she makes a vow: "I shall beg for love no longer. I will never love nor be loved…

In middle school, Cheol Im was a living legend for his fighting prowess. Years later, he learns that his childhood friend from the orphanage, Sol Kim, was bullied to death. Determined to get revenge, Cheol returns to school. But his plans take an unexpected turn when Ha-yun Seo, a fellow orphan who was like a sister to him, is assigned as a teacher at that very same school.
Now, Cheol is forced to…

entries.t: My Second Life is a Healing Life?
entries.d:
Eugene Pellivia, the youngest son of a legendary warrior family, is on the brink of death—until he’s visited by Pellin, the fabled Mage of Creation, and given a second chance at life.

Determined to follow in the footsteps of the one who saved him, Eugene sets out to become a great mage and use his powers for good. But fate has other plans, and before long, he's drawn into the shadows …

“What have I done wrong?” That’s the question Hyo-in An asks herself as she’s ignored and bullied by her former friends at school. She used to get along with everyone, until Juhye Kim and the other kids she thought were her friends began excluding her from their group and treating her horribly. But Hyo-in has an ace up her sleeve that could turn this whole situation around.…

After global warming destroyed the Earth, humanity set off for the uncharted planet paradise known as "Arcadia." Crew member Yeongsu Dong wakes up from stasis to find himself the lone survivor, orbitting the planet in the debris field of the wrecked ship. He gets to the surface, where he is immediately attacked by wild creatures, and gets caught in the civil war among the native Arcadians. He must…

Verden, a first-tier mage with a genius intellect but no innate magical talent, is condemned to life as a secret test subject after a devastating betrayal at the Magic Tower. Driven by a thirst for revenge and survival, he develops the "Theory of Celestial Reversal," unlocking limitless potential. But with the tower’s dark forces still looming and mysterious organizations entwining with his …

Tired of being exploited by his job on Planet Alpha Uri, an alien finds escape by possessing the body of a human with the highest magic energy on Earth. Unfortunately, his dreams of a carefree life are dashed when he wakes up as Giryeo, a weak F-rank hunter whose magic can't be activated for some reason. Can the new Giryeo level up and learn how to survive in a world filled with dangerous gates an…

entries.t: The Tale of a Fox's Love
entries.d: Yeon is a powerful gumiho with a distrust for love and an even bigger distrust towards humans, but what will happen when she gets involved with Dong-i, a poor painter who defies all her expectations of human nature? Will Yeon finally get the happy ending she deserves, or will she pay the price for falling in love with a mortal?

Branded a heartless and cruel sovereign, Emperor Herace of the Tevente Empire has lost three empresses to betrayal and murder. Into his life steps Eleanor Snow, the fearless daughter of House Snow, offering herself as his new empress to protect her family from ruin. In a world of assassins, treachery, and political unrest, their alliance is forged out of necessity but eventually tempered by trust.…

No one knows why these people are stranded here with death looming in the corner. As loneliness creeps in, it becomes all too easy to seek solace in others. But they must trust no one but themselves. Remember, the goal is to survive.

In a world of sorcery, where items can become wands, Sano, a young sorcerer whose entire arm is blessed with the power of a god, struggles to fulfill his prophesied destiny, hailed as the Trinity, savior of the world.
Fearing he may be quite the opposite with ominous visions seemingly seeking to steer him down darker paths, Sano dreams of protecting the world from a devastating event known as the …

Carjacked and hit by a truck, Park Min Seo wakes up as Madelyn Roseheart, a frail baron’s daughter destined to marry the terrifying Duke of the North, Torsten Icewood. But Min Seo has no interest in romance—she’s a businesswoman who wants nothing more than to annul the engagement and start fresh. The twist? The Duke is none other than her carjacker, who was also reincarnated here…

Reborn as the prince and princess of a fantastical land, Arienne Yuriana and her twin brother, Arhen, should have been living a life of luxury… But instead of beautiful palaces, magical adventures, and attentive servants, the twins are left by the emperor to live with their abusive mother in a rundown castle full of cruel maids. However, after a freak accident suddenly leaves them without a…

entries.t: Daisy: How to Become the Duke's Fiancée
entries.d: Sweet, timid Daisy meets a tragic end after being betrayed by the man she loves. When she is given a second chance at life, she vows not to repeat the same mistakes of the past! The only problem is that she must pay off her father’s gambling debt to Kilian, an aristocrat with a terrifying reputation. One option will take her 60 years, and the other, just three... but it involves a contract m…

Kasai was only a boy when he watched his parents die, not from blades or bullets, but as their very souls were ripped away. No one believed him. No one but Naraka, a ruthless mafia syndicate that raised him into their perfect weapon.

Now, years later, Kasai has escaped the underworld, desperate to bury his bloodstained past. But when Naraka comes hunting, fate delivers him into the hands of a mys…

Cat and Bird have been best friends for practically their entire life and thought they always would be. All of that starts to change after some crossed boundaries at a party, where their friendship is tested and Cat meets a new friend Dog. What follows is a tale of love, friendship and some inter-dimensional adventure sprinkled in as Cat, Bird and Dog have to navigate an ever changing world as wel…

The rift brought an end to the world humanity once knew. Monsters claimed the lives of countless people, and those with supernatural powers known as hunters became humanity’s last hope. For Jiho Lee, becoming a hunter wasn’t a choice, but a result of losing everything. Now, in the aftermath, she begins forming new ties and gradually rebuilding a life on her own terms.

entries.t: I Will Become the Villain's Poison Taster
entries.d: After waking up in the body of Giselle Rozevin, possibly the worst character from the novel, “The Poisoned Apple,” our protagonist has one goal: escape the original Giselle’s miserable fate of being poisoned to death by assassins while trapped in a prison cell. Thankfully and strangely, she finds out that poison is ineffective on her and that she can distinguish them by taste. Th…

entries.t: The Dying Villainess's Path to a Happy Ending
entries.d: As Clea Rino died, she made a desperate plea to make her wish come true. The demon king, fascinated by this, hastily injected the soul of someone from Korea into Clea's body and proposed a deal. If Clea's wish comes true, he will let the wayward soul go back to Korea. Now, the new inhabitant of Clea's body has to successfully remain happily married to Grand Duke Isaac Detroi for six months, deal w…

After another soul-crushing day at the office, Chaesu wakes up inside the world of Campfire Friends, a cartoon he used to watch as a child. As he spends more time with his colorful woodland pals every night, he begins to regain his lost childhood innocence. But behind their cheery kindness hides a chilling secret...

entries.t: The End of an Imperfect Divorce
entries.d: After a life of neglect and a cold, loveless marriage to Duke Johann Leopold, Olivia Blanchett’s desperate attempts at love fail… until one day, Jian Han awakens in Olivia’s body. She seeks a divorce and flees to a rival kingdom, where she meets the charming but cunning Marquess Edgar Lancelot. Olivia is eager to start over and live her own life, all while her ex-husband secretl…

What life is there for a creature forever trapped in a cage? Such questions ring true for Isabella Heloise, illegitimate child of an abusive count who uses her as a pawn for his political ambitions. When Isabella's betrothal to an influential noble is broken off, her value within the Heloise household plummets, prompting her to flee from her father’s violence. Isabella finds herself alone an…

entries.t: When Pride Fell at My Feet
entries.d: The beautiful Duke Enrico Michele approached like a devil whispering sweet lies, offering a cunning deal. "Just dance for me like a living doll. In return, I'll tell you about your dead parents." Along with his mysterious patronage came a chilling question: "Don't you want to know the truth?" And so began my secret, dangerous entanglement with the Duke, a meeting that should never have happened.

entries.t: The Serpent in the Empress’s Chamber
entries.d: Despite devoting her body and soul to Emperor Laxus and helping him rise to power as an illegitimate son, Empress Lenisha loses her family and is cast out of the palace due to the Emperor’s paranoid suspicion that she might betray him. Now, Lenisha has only one goal: to bring him down. To do so, she chooses a new husband and ally in Kassius, a war hero brimming with fiery vitality. And so be…

entries.t: This is What First Love Is Like, Your Majesty
entries.d:
Once cursed to never love, Crown Prince Kalart stuns the royal ball by declaring his love… for a hefty black cat that looks more suited to a back alley than a palace. Determined to win the cat’s affection, he brings its seemingly ordinary owner, Roserikta, into the royal palace.
But appearances can be deceiving—Roserikta is clearly hiding something… something magical.
Thu…

Ddeosari Cha, or Plankie, lost her family to an alien attack years ago and is bullied for her unusual name and obsession with aliens. When two mysterious Kudoomians– aliens with pink blood, disguised as humans– appear to capture her, she fights back using a strange power… the ability to control the stars. Outnumbered and outmatched, suddenly a blue alien steps into the fray, off…

Ten years ago, Yeonju left Eunseong, the man she loved, to protect his budding career. Now a stylist and devoted single mom to her son, Hanbyeol, she's shocked to learn that the lead actor of her next film is the very man she walked away from...

Bo-yeong and Haewon have been dating for ten years since they met at university. The two have been through thick and thin together, supporting each other every step of the way. But at some point, their relationship began to feel strained. They thought they knew each other better than anyone after a decade together. But they're starting to realize that as time passes, it's becoming increasingly dif…

It all started with a retirement. A legend in the underworld of killers and assassins, Sihyeok Cha, otherwise known as “The Red Shirt,” leaves a life of violence behind for his loving wife Miju and their unborn child. Little did he expect, however, that bonds made in blood cannot be so easily erased. When tragedy strikes, Sihyeok is dragged back into the deadly struggle between mob fac…

Sanghyeon Kim has the talent and the drive to become a K-pop star—but one thing keeps holding him back: a false school bullying accusation. After countless rejections, his dream feels more distant than ever. But when the head director of a major entertainment company hands him a mysterious bath bomb that transforms him into his past-life self, he's suddenly staring at an unbelievably beautif…

Shy and unpopular Dasom Park rushes to meet her only friend, the beautiful and adored, Iseul Chae. Instead, she finds Iseul's dead body, or rather, its hollow shell. Dasom enters it and takes over Iseul's seemingly perfect life. But as Dasom discovers horrific family secrets, she wonders where her friend went, and if it was an accident she ended up in Iseul's shell.

A century ago, Agito Yatsurugi and his comrades saved humanity by slaying the six dragons that invaded Earth through magical gates. As he lay dying, he learned the dragons would return in 100 years to awaken the dragon god and end the world. Granted a second chance, Agito awakens in the body of Agito Mitsurugi, a powerless F-rank student at a magic academy. With time running out, he must rally new…

A blinding flash of light, and his village was gone.
Lowe vows to reach the floating Island of the Gods, but first, he must venture into a world ruled by a ranking system and claw his way to the top. Trained by the world’s strongest knight, he embarks on a quest to become the top ranker, battling fearsome beasts and ruthless rivals to uncover the truth and save his loved ones.
Just a totally normal duke who will not stand for these popular - but cliche - shenanigans!

Neither school nor home is an inviting place for top student Junyeong Yun. Like a stray cat, she wanders into the woods until she comes across an abandoned house, which proves to be the perfect place for her to study in peace. Well, it would be the perfect place, if it weren’t for the fact that she has to share it with the school’s notorious bad boy, Beomjin Kwon. Although the two seem…

Born the illegitimate daughter of a powerful tycoon, Soyeong Ji has spent her life sidelined and scorned by the Ji family. Believing marriage will be her escape, her hopes are shattered when she catches her fiancé in bed with her half-sister. Betrayed and alone, Soyeong chooses vengeance by seducing her sister’s lover and setting a calculated plan in motion to bring them all down.

Marrying your childhood best friend and first love may sound like a dream come true – but not for Renee. After marrying into a contract marriage with Alexander, Renee faces all sorts of trouble, but none can match her own husband’s cold shoulder. However, a magical wish might change everything. Can a simple wish save Renee’s failing marriage?

“Facing the truth only distances you from vengeance. And the stronger your opponent, the further you have to remove yourself from the truth.”
Castle. The criminal organization that gathers in the Castle Hotel in Gangnam. Eight years ago, they killed Shin Kim’s father. Then they killed his mentor. Now, he wants revenge-- and he knows just the people he’ll need to get the job…

"Welcome to Another World. Exciting adventures with millions of other users await you!" Or at least, that's what Jiseok was promised when logging in. Instead, he finds himself alone with nothing but an ordinary shovel to fend off ferocious beasts, evil dragons, and... some dude in tighty-whities? Now, Jiseok's only got two choices - dig or die.

entries.t: Disney - As Old As Time: A Twisted Tale
entries.d: Clever and imaginative, Belle longs to escape her provincial town to find adventure. Only, Belle’s father won’t leave. He’s waiting for her mother to return— a mother Belle can’t remember. But when Belle’s father is taken prisoner by a terrifying Beast, she offers to take his place to save his life. Belle finds the Beast’s enchanted rose, and when she touc…

It's a new day and a new beginning for the Earth's Mightiest Heroes, with a brand new team that's bigger and better than ever before! And they won't just be 'Earth's Mightiest Heroes', either - when the galaxy is in danger, the Avengers will answer the call!

THE ICONIC CINEMATIC TERROR MAKES ITS MARVEL DEBUT! Gabriel Cruz gave his life to Weyland-Yutani--In the case of an alien attack he barely survived, almost literally! Recently retired, Cruz is trying to patch things up with his abandoned son with the help of his friend, a Bishop-model android, but his re-entry into civilian life is not going smoothly…and his encounters with the deadly Xenom…

Luke Skywalker and the ragtag band of rebels fighting against the Galactic Empire are fresh off their biggest victory yet--the destruction of the massive battle station known as the Death Star. But the Empire's not toppled yet! Join Luke along with Princess Leia, smugglers Han Solo and Chewbacca, droids C-3PO and R2-D2 and the rest of the Rebel Alliance as they strike out for freedom against the e…

Peter Parker is on the outs with the Avengers, the Fantastic Four and even Aunt May! But what did Spider-Man do that has alienated him from everyone? And what’s going on with Peter and Mary Jane? Doctor Octopus is out to get his archnemesis, the Master Planner is unleashing fresh schemes and the gangster called Tombstone is masking some shocking moves that will culminate in a truly brutal sh…

entries.t: The Returned C-Rank Tank Won't Die!
entries.d: Betrayed by her team and abandoned to die in a dungeon, timid C-rank hunter Cho-i Hyeon discovers a cursed ring that keeps her alive by endlessly regenerating her body. Time stretches into years as she’s killed over and over, unable to escape. When she finally does, she’s no longer the girl who was left behind. Stronger, colder, and haunted by something growing inside her, she wants an…

Picture this: It’s your final year of high school, and you can’t wait to get out there and live your best life. You blush at the popular kid, and eye the new transfer student with bruises on his face. You’re looking forward to the future… Until you wake up in the future, with no memory of the last six years. Suddenly finding herself as a 25-year-old aspiring actress, Miyeo…

In a world where blue snow freezes everything it touches, humanity has long forgotten what warmth feels like. Seonu, a teenage boy with a prosthetic leg, carries the lifeless body of Iseo through the snow-covered wasteland, determined to bring her home one final time. The snow will soon erase his footsteps but not the promise that keeps him moving.

Taeseong, an actor past his prime known for playing gangster roles, accidentally switches places with a real-life gangster named Mun-gil. Taeseong’s life suddenly turns into a scriptless scene filled with dangerous thugs! One wrong move could mean the end for him. Will Taeseong be able to make it out alive in this world of real gangsters?

entries.t: Woke Up as the CEO’s Dog
entries.d: After a rough day and a run-in with a missing dog, overworked office worker Umi Seo wakes up to a surreal nightmare: she’s trapped in the body of her boss’s beloved pet. By day, Umi is a dog. By night, she’s back to being human. Forced to live under one roof with the aloof CEO, Chahyeon Baek, the two begin to grow closer in the most unexpected way. But can Umi ever return to her …

Past the grey desert and across the ocean lay the demon lands. Bloodthirsty and savage, they've waged war with the humans since anyone can remember. And seated on his throne, behind castle walls and royal guards, sits the demon king. At least, that's what everyone thinks. And if Merlin ever wants to see his brother again, he'd better make sure everyone goes on believing he's the demon king. Otherw…

Minjun wished for the world to end-- until it did. When a zombie appears at his door, the bullied teen chooses to fight for survival. Teaming up with Yena, his sassy yet charming classmate, he flees the collapsing city. Hunted by the infected and haunted by enemies old and new, they discover that in a world without rules, trust may be their only chance at survival.

Cheolsu is a loser in life and a loser in-game... until he’s suddenly promoted to Goblin Summoner. He’s shocked when he discovers that his goblin summon is a hideous, max-level monster capable of obliterating any foe with a single attack! There’s just one catch, though--his new buddy can’t be unsummoned, and it draws way too much attention. Now stuck with an overpowered pet…

Dayeol hears two guys fooling around in the nurse’s office and accidentally knocks over the curtain rod. When the nurse walks in on the scene, devilishly handsome Taehyun tells her that Dayeol tried to make out with him. Before Dayeol can correct the misunderstanding, the rumor spreads and his archery scholarship is in jeopardy. To make matters worse, Taehyun doesn’t show the slightest…

After a wild turn of events, Yoon Kiom ends up being kidnapped by demon fanatics and is about to be sacrificed to summon a demon, whatever that is. Just when her kidnappers are about to end her life, a gorgeous man interrupts the ritual and saves all the hostages' lives. However, this was only the start of Kiom's troubles. Her rescuer, who keeps calling her "Sion," forces himself into her house an…

entries.t: How to Send Your Husband to Hell
entries.d:
Helena Winston, the dazzling diva of noble society, is thrust into scandal when the crown prince unexpectedly confesses his love.
To protect the Empire—and her own reputation—the Empress proposes a secret deal: marry a man of her choosing and expose his secrets. Her target? Count Benjamin Ischpern, a veiled noble rumored to be tied to enemies of the throne.
As Helena begins her life in…

It's been three years since Yeong-in and Seonghyeok parted ways. So why is Seonghyeok approaching her now -- gentler, and more intense than ever? Will their reunion end differently than before? Can they fill the emptiness in each other's hearts?

Max and Joy may sit just inches apart at work, but they're miles apart in every other way. Max prefers to be a fly on the wall, while Joy is the office's social butterfly. So when Max accidentally sees something on Joy's work laptop he wasn't meant to, he's pulled off the wall and thrown straight into the tangled web of workplace dynamics. Maybe this change is exactly what he needed... or is it?

entries.t: The Monkey King’s Journey to the Murim
entries.d:
The Monkey King’s  journey was over. 

But a new story begins with an impossible crime -- his master, Sanzang, has gone missing. His new mission is to dive into the Murim, a world where mortals and their martial arts rival the power of the gods and unravel this mystery.

The threads of fate reveal not only allies, but foes from his past. 
The Great Sage, Heaven’s Equal has been unchain…

Struggling streamer Doyeon Choi downloads a mysterious dating sim game, Heart-Racing Ghost Dating Sim, only to find himself trapped in a deadly loop-- where the love interests are real-life ghosts with unresolved deaths. From haunted highways to murder cases, Doyeon must navigate a world where romance, horror, and mystery collide. Every wrong move could cost him his life...again.
This series conta…

The bond of family can be a star that guides us in the night, or a chain that drags us down. For aspiring hunter Seunghyeon Gi, both are true. He dreams of becoming a legendary hunter like his father, despite his bitterness at his family’s preoccupation with his comatose sister, Sohyeon. Everything changes when Sohyeon suddenly regains consciousness and reveals herself as a ‘Homecomer&…

Ha-yoon’s freshman year of college isn’t particularly noteworthy. She became a fashion design major because it was a good fit for her GPA, she has no friends except the incredibly popular and gorgeous Soo-ah, and she has a crush on handsome upperclassman Jihoon. She’s content with her life as it is, but everything changes with a single post online. Now, a whole world of greed and…

entries.t: When the Archduke’s Leash Is Pulled
entries.d:
Jenna, a girl cursed to see others’ emotions as light, awakens as an extra in a novel.
Yearning for a quiet life, she settles in a forest cabin—only to discover it belongs to Enoch Winchester, a cursed duke cloaked in an ominous black light.
When Enoch realizes Jenna may hold the key to breaking his curse, he proposes a contract: she must spend time with him each day and come whenever …

Welcome to the Containment Zone, where every space is warped by anomalies and bound by deadly rules. From unholy hospitals to sinister arcades, the four-man team of Department 2 ventures in daily to study the spaces and bring back supplies. Things are always guaranteed to get bizarre, but the job has to be done... no matter how many deaths it causes.

Shihu Lee has logged 20,000 hours playing Let's Kill the Demon Lord! for the past 5 years. But when the game takes a turn he doesn't like, Shihu cancels his pre-order of the DLC in anger, only to find himself sucked into the game! Now in the body of Julian Kreipart Prason, the villain, he has to play the part perfectly to survive the many enemies around him while unable to use the moonlight blade,…

Aubrey Sandalwood had one goal: to hide her past as a slave, and become the perfect lady in high society. But at her long-awaited debut party, she runs into a man from her past— the boy who rescued her from the island she was trapped on. Colhard Karnus, the only one who knows her secret.

"This series contains themes regarding child abuse and trauma that may not be suitable for all readers. …

She was sent to spy on him. Falling for him was never part of the plan.
Hyewon Yoon works tirelessly to secure her future, but loyalty comes at a cost. Vice President Jiseok Ha makes her track every move of his cousin, Executive Director Taebeom Ha.
Taebeom knows she’s spying on him. But instead of pushing her away, he keeps her close. What begins as a cold arrangement shifts into something …

What if you could undo your dark past? Chaebom Yu, a burned-out office worker, wakes up as her 17-year-old self, given a second chance to rewrite her life. She enters high school determined to avoid the mistakes that once haunted her. But the more she tries to fix things, the weirder her life becomes. Money starts slipping away, and strange boys keep showing up… Her “do-over” be…

Woori Nam has always been the golden boy—wealthy, carefree, and untouchably lucky. But on the leap day of 2028, his 7th real birthday, everything changes. A seemingly harmless reunion with an old classmate, Subin Shin, ends in a brutal murder. And then, inexplicably, Woori wakes up back in high school, right beside Subin who has no idea that he just killed his deskmate. Trapped in a deadly t…

One day, the disgraced child actress Sara Gwon takes her own life, only to wake up… ten years in the past? Except now, she is successful, radiant, and adored by all. What happened? How did she go from public enemy number one to national sweetheart? And more importantly, can her fate truly be rewritten this time?

entries.t: How to Hide the Emperor's Child
entries.d: After dedicating ten years of her life to Kaizen, Astelle is divorced by him as soon as he becomes the emperor, making her reign as empress the shortest one in history. Because of her decision to go through with the divorce, she is also disowned by her family, leaving her no choice but to raise her (and Kaizen's) son, Theore, alone. Six years pass by without much trouble, until one day, Kaizen's s…

Bo-eun has recently acquired a furry little roommate named Dallae (Korean for azalea), who she met in an azalea field. Dallae has her own schedule, though, and comes and goes as she pleases. Meanwhile, Bo-eun can’t seem to stop dreaming about a missed friendship in high school – her name is Saeyeon. Oddly enough, it was around the time that Dallae started showing up that Bo-eun started…

On a dark, quiet night, as Se-a returns to her empty home, flickering lights reveal a man in a cap standing at her doorstep. He calls her name, and when she turns, she’s stunned by the familiar face: someone she believed had died ten years ago. Letting him in sets off a chain of unraveling truths, buried secrets, and painful misunderstandings. But he’s not the only one hiding something…

Kuro's dreams come true. So when he dreams about a falling meteor, and walking through the woods at 3 am to hear a voice calling out "Help me!"—that's exactly what he does. In the midst of a storm, Kuro saves the meteor's tiny alien pilot, a sludgy little guy who fits into a Slushie cup.

Slushii is very cute, super friendly . . . and clearly hiding something. What he does admit is so bizarr…

Love, money, fame… They all come to Paradise Island chasing different things, but what they find is a nightmare. Oreum joins 15 other participants on a reality dating show, hoping to win prize money that could save her sister’s life. But when a mysterious virus spreads, turning people into flesh-hungry monsters, trust crumbles, terror rises, and Oreum’s only goal becomes making …

entries.t: The Spy Life in the Demonic Sect
entries.d: Iseo Jang, the Murim Alliance’s prodigy spy, has spent 14 years deep undercover in the Demon Sect, earning the ruthless title of “Rabid Dog” for his work as their counterintelligence agent. But his newest mission is his most absurd yet: make the Sect’s laziest, most notorious delinquent -- Wu Ma -- the next Cheonma. To pull it off, Iseo ditches his post and applies to be Wu…

entries.t: The Villainess is Bothered By Male Leads
entries.d: All she wanted was an easy life as a noble woman. Instead, Laura Jay found herself involved with a series of drama and a number of courters. She didn't sign up for all the excitement. "Just leave me alone!"

Lady Carinne is in danger of being sold off in a political marriage, but the arrangement falls through when she spends a night with a mysterious stranger, willingly conceiving his child. Her spiteful father locks her away as punishment for years, until one day - another suitor steps forward, offering to marry Carinne and take her child in. When she arrives at his castle, however, she realizes he i…

What happens after you fall out of love? Nevaeh Solene was engaged to the Duke, Baler Eustache. But for ten long winters, she endured in a relationship that was not meant to be. After calling off her engagement, Nevaeh moves to another country, hoping to lead a quiet life. But there she meets Emperor Arendt, who wants to give her the love she’s never had. Will Nevaeh’s eternal winter f…

Andrew is the only daughter of the famous Grace family. She also has an incurable disease. Due to her family’s high status in society, Andrew grew up with no friends save for her maid, Herta, whom she has become intensely infatuated with. Little does she know, her family is responsible for ruining Herta’s life. Can Andrew break the hierarchy and be with her? Or will Herta end her suffe…

What if a myth from 300 years ago wasn’t just a myth? According to Joseon legends, it has been told that Haechi, the youngest son of the Jade Emperor, was inseparable from the Princess So-yang. Following the recent discovery of the princess’s tomb, Lee Young-gwang is chosen to curate the exhibition. However, it seems there were more than just ruins in the tomb that was excavated&hellip…

entries.t: Leveling Up in an Exclusive Dungeon
entries.d:
Guilds are there to protect hunters, right? Right...?
Nope. All they seem to protect is their own interests. As they monopolize hunting grounds, the monsters, and even the XP points, Jinhyeok, our MC and a hunter without guild affiliation, is left bouncing from one part-time job to another just to scrape by. What he needs is an opening. A shot. A crack in the system. Then the universe provides one…

After 30 years in the other world and defeating the demon lord, Cheolho Kang finally returns to Earth-- only to find it overrun with monsters and hunters. Tired of endless battles, he opens a small restaurant and wishes to live in peace. 
With dishes to make and a baby dragon to raise, a heartwarming tale where every visitor brings a story is set to begin.

Yu-eun is a burned-out designer whose sole hobby is gaming. Just when she decides to take a break for once and enjoy her pastime, she is met with a system error. But wait... why is the error screen appearing before her in real life?! That’s when Yu-eun is transported into the game as her character, where she soon finds her place working as a talented designer at a boutique on 97 Sheldon Stre…

Star chef, Lee Rim’s life fell apart a year ago when he lost his sense of smell and taste. For a whole year, he stayed holed up in his house, devastated at the fact that his cooking career was over. However, the immersive VR game “Real,” provided Rim, who goes as “Rice” in the game, with a way to cope with reality. Real restored all five of his senses, enabling him to…

Geonyeong is a brilliant girl. Despite being underprivileged, her exceptional intellect allows her to enroll in the prestigious Pyeonghyeon High School. 
There, she meets new competitors and friends. She struggles to compete with all the other privileged students who have expensive lessons.
Amidst these challenges, she is determined to succeed and become a judge. This is Geonyeong's journey to pro…

When her mother remarries into the Arpad dukedom, Ophelia finds herself uprooted into the Arpad nobility. However, due to a tragic carriage accident, Ophelia's mother and stepfather suddenly lose their lives. Alexander, her stepbrother, urges her to stay in the Arpad household for the next three years. One day, Ophelia hears devastating news from an investigator that changes everything. "The death…

entries.t: The Circumstances of the Lying Empress
entries.d: Peace is a prize that must be won at all costs– but what if that peace is based on a lie? When palace maid Kochun discovers a shocking secret about the princess of the enemy kingdom married to her emperor, her life is cast into turmoil as she becomes embroiled in palace intrigue surrounding the new empress. A kind yet courageous soul, Kochun vows to remain loyal as the empress’s person…

entries.t: The Day the Real One Appeared
entries.d:
Ever since falling ill as a child, Mel Slofi has had white hair. However, this trait brings her more than she bargained for when it leads her to be mistaken for the lost daughter of a duke-- even being told by the duke’s son to keep up the facade in order to protect his fragile father.
But when Mel sees a mysterious woman at a grand ball who perfectly matches the photos she’s seen of t…

entries.t: The Pure Heart of a Monster
entries.d: Deep beneath the ocean lies the Alabaster Sea Kingdom, where its king, Taerang, faces a deadly curse. Born without a heart, he must steal one from a woman who truly loves him or die on his 25th birthday. Having given up all hope as his cursed body convulses at any woman's touch, everything changes when a mysterious woman named Sollu appears. Now, the arrogant king must race against time to win her…

What does it take for an animal to live and survive? What would it choose to die for?
A T. rex, washed ashore and stranded on an island for over 20 years, waits for the day he can take his final breath. But just when that moment seems near, hope arrives.
A collection of stories about the great creatures that have roamed the Earth before us.

Everyone dreams of knocking out their insufferable boss, but what if that boss is a war hero, a duke, and constantly breathing down your neck? For Chloe, enduring Curtis's relentless inspections was a daily struggle... Until a royal marriage decree offers her an unexpected way out.

Sanghyeon has the uncanny ability to absorb powers of magical artifacts—by devouring them. But it took him thirty years to master, and at fifty-five, it’s too late to escape mediocrity. Then one day, he’s miraculously sent back in time to the fateful day he awakened his powers as a monster-hunting player. With a chance for a do-over, he wastes no time using his ability to its ful…

entries.t: Raising the Second Male Lead’s Son
entries.d: Our protagonist wakes up one day to find herself as Elia, the daughter of a bankrupt baron and a side character in a romance-fantasy novel. While on the run from debt collectors, she saves a child from an attacker -- only to be accused of being the kidnapper by the child’s guardian, Duke Kaiden. Taken to his mansion, she’s forced to live with them and be the child’s nanny. Can El…

Ji-u Shin has been transported into her own dating game. Her life inside the game is now being broadcast live across the cosmos. If she wants the broadcast to end, she must win the game. The catch? The game is set to the hardest difficulty, and she’s been cast as the notorious villainess, Theresa. If she fails to win, she will lose her life. Can she avoid all of Theresa’s bad endings a…

Hanjun is the weakest hunter alive. While others wield powerful skills, he’s stuck with a useless copy-paste ability and mocked by everyone around him. Cursed during the Great Calamity, he has only five years left to live… but Hanjun refuses to give up. When a chance discovery reveals his skill’s hidden potential, everything changes. As he rises through the ranks, a new calamity…

entries.t: The Regressed Doctor Just Wanted to Live Quietly
entries.d:
In the operating room, Dr. Jinhyeok Lee is flawless—unyielding, brilliant, and untouchable. But outside, he’s a ghost to his family and loved ones. He misses everything, even his mother’s final moments. By the time he understands what he’s lost, it’s too late… until it isn’t.
He wakes up 27 years in the past. Now armed with a lifetime of memories, Jinhyeo…

entries.t: The Monster Dame Requests Maternity Leave
entries.d: Lucia is the captain of the imperial knights and a swordmaster famous for her extraordinary achievements. However, she regrets something on her deathbed: unknowingly aiding a nefarious group in their plot to sacrifice the saintess for profit. So when she wakes up in the past as her 25-year-old self, Lucia is determined to rescue the child saintess and keep her safe until she’s old enough to …

Buldo Jeong was once a legend of the Korean underworld. But after a decade in prison, he walks free into a world that no longer plays by the old rules. The streets are run by a new wave of criminals known as the “MZ Gang” who are louder, flashier, and far more reckless. Though he intended to leave his past behind, he’s pushed to the edge when the youngbloods hurt those around him…

Alex has one goal in life: attend the greatest magic university and become a powerful wizard. But just as his dreams are about to come true, he is branded as one of his kingdom's Five Legendary Heroes. And, as fate would have it, he's the one destined to die. Burdened by the Mark of the Fool, Alex's magic no longer works as it once did. The Mark interferes directly with the power he's spent every …

Derek lives by one creed. Fight, adapt, and rely only on himself. In the years after the System arrived on Earth and warped it into a monster-ridden wasteland, those rules forged him into one of Earth’s most powerful warriors. They let him thrive in the face of the Apocalypse — until the day he broke them. Failed by his teammates and sent through the void into an entirely new world, fa…

You know what’s worse than breaking up with your girlfriend? Getting stuck on a sadistic alien gameshow with her cat. Join Carl and Princess Donut as they try to survive the end of the world — or just get to the next level of a trap-filled fantasy dungeon.

When Bilinda Baker arrives in the remote Cornish town of Tredregyn, she finds her new colleagues about as welcoming as the harsh coastline. But she soon makes friends with Maggie Warren, a very fun local woman with very unorthodox beliefs. What does a trainee priest do when she finds out her new best friend works at the Church of Satan? What's the housekeeper's problem? And why does Reverend Penro…

Everyone assumes Bonnie is a ditsy redhead barely surviving corporate life until a late-night office attack reveals her true nature: sharp, capable, and deadly. Her unexpected display of skill draws the attention of the Fianna, a secret organization that wastes no time recruiting her as an apprentice assassin. To her surprise, Bonnie thrives in this dangerous new world. But one obstacle remains: R…

Ema Nakahara has never killed anyone. She's just a girl trying to make it in the cutthroat music industry, stuck as the forever intern. But when she suddenly finds her first big break as the lead singer of Starfruit, an up-and-coming queer band, it is immediately plagued by misfortune: cancelled gigs, a scummy manager, a dead body—and a lot of secrets to keep.

The band doesn't deserve this.…

Ryugeom Cheok, a loyal Goryeo warrior, throws himself off a cliff with his enemy to protect his master—only to be frozen in ice for 900 years. Awakened in the modern era, the greatest swordsman of Goryeo begins his journey of vengeance…

Elementary school teacher Gijeong Go has lost almost everything: her parents when she was a child, her freedom when she had to support her shut-in younger brother, and now her very dignity as the class bully among her students and his mother threaten to turn her life into a living hell. Upon meeting the mild-mannered yet inscrutable lawyer Inseop Oh, Gijeong begins to find her life changing, thoug…

entries.t: The Beast Won't Let Me Sleep
entries.d:
Adele is a notorious villainess among the high society; rumor has it she married and murdered an old marquis, then allegedly seduced her stepson out of lust for power. As such, she’s shunned and ostracized at social gatherings-- until she meets the most sought-after man of the era, Count Vyce.

However, this man turns out to be Chris, the poor boy she looked after before abandoning him long …

Taeu and Jieun are friends—just friends. Both of them were comfortable with this arrangement, with neither holding any romantic feelings for the other. However, when Jieun returns from summer break looking noticeably different, Taeu’s feelings for his friend begin to change, and new feelings of jealousy and confusion taking their place.

When Jieun develops a crush on a handsome classm…

Rai has been secretly crushing on her childhood friend Dogyeong for years. To hide her feelings, she pretends to be a die-hard fan of the K-pop group DIMPLE, especially of Neulchan, her "ultimate bias." It's all just fun and games to make Dogyeong a little jealous... until Neulchan suddenly transfers to her school. With her fake idol crush now a real part of her life, her friendship with Dogyeong …

For two decades, Actress Kang Seo has been haunted by terrible nightmares. Then, out of the blue, San Han, the man who always rescued her in those dreams, appears before her in real life as her personal bodyguard. Will Kang be able to uncover the true identity of this mysterious figure?

Heavy are the shoulders that bear the burden of a household. To keep his waning clan afloat, leader Mujin Baek has no choice but to leave his homeland and venture out into the martial arts realm. When he passes the entrance exam of the Northern Sky Union with flying colors—leaving behind one unconscious opponent in the process—Mujin soon finds that the realm is not the noble place he o…

Deoksun Kim, a 111-year-old mogul, built a thriving food empire, but her one regret was never experiencing true love. Miraculously reincarnated as 25-year-old Dohui, she sets out to fulfill her dying wish—only to be betrayed by her lover and lose everything. 
Fueled by vengeance, she soon faces an impossible ultimatum: fall in love within 111 days or suffer eternal torment in Hell. With time…
