You know him as the legendary Ranker, Urek Mazino—but once, he was just another Regular, climbing the Tower alongside both teammates and enemies. What awaits him after charging into the Tower, chasing after Phantaminum? Whatever it is he desires... will he find it there?

Romance, flowers, and dates-- once upon a time, that was the perfect description of Haesu and Mincheol. Now, all Haesu has is the ashes of their marriage and a mountain of debt. But her world shatters completely when Mincheol cheats on her with a young coworker. Hurt and betrayed, Haesu finds herself drawn to Taeha, a young man who seems desperate for her affection… and may be hiding more t…

That song… It sounds like my brother’s unreleased track!
Just before his untimely death, Su-in’s beloved older brother recorded an album dedicated to him – a final gift that was soon forgotten in a desk drawer. Years later, Su-in hears one of those tracks on TV, and it’s being claimed by his brother’s former bandmate.
Now, Su-in must take the stage, beat the co…

Maria, Empress of Rastonia, is betrayed by her husband Emperor Henry after his mistress gives birth to a son. King Helland the Great, ruler of a neighboring kingdom, takes her as collateral so that Henry can have one more year to repay a considerable debt.
King Helland is actually Gunther Preisley, a former slave for Maria’s family. He has loved her a decade and is determined to woo her. Mea…

The strongest god in the world craves just one thing: the thrill of a real fight. Tired of being unbeatable, Mu – god of Earth – possesses the body of a weak high schooler to relive the joy of combat. But when his divine form is sealed by his enemy, Mu must grow stronger in his new mortal body to fight back. Can fists alone satisfy a god’s hunger... or will his obsession be his d…

Sunny is the spoiled and lonely heir to the Yongwha fortune, but when it all comes. crashing down he's going to have to learn some serious life skills quickly. A chance encounter with Hyun-joo, a farmer from the country side, offers him a lifeline, but only if he's willing to put aside his vanity and get his hands dirty doing honest work. Maybe with Hyun-joo he'll be able to make love bloom in the…

Hitmen? In this economy? It doesn't pay enough for Vincent (codename: Mr. Noir), so he has to make pizzas to pay the rent. But Vincent's fortunes change when he's offered a chance at a million dollars to take out Dragonfly, the best assassin around and his hitman-work-crush. The catch? There might be something linking Dragonfly and the cute girl who he just agreed to live with.

There are delinquents in every school. Ashen is one of them. To make it worse, his father is a powerful politician, meaning he can get away with basically anything. To Sarith, who just wants to lead a peaceful school life, Ashen is someone that should be avoided at all costs. But what happens when they’re forced into situations together and Sarith sees a whole different side of Ashen - One w…

Uce, a down-on-his-luck young man, dreams of becoming the champion in the brutal and legendary War of Corpses—a sport where necromancers and their knights battle for supremacy. In a desperate bid, he revives Eleonora, an abandoned corpse who claims to have been the deadliest mercenary alive.
There are two big problems, though.
One, Eleonora is alive — a fact that cannot be revealed at …

Number is not your average serial killer. Equipped with the ability to identify future murderers, Number takes the law into his own hands. He believes in ridding the world of destined killers. Simple, right? One day, he runs into Jihyeon, whose number changes constantly as she develops a special power of her own. Will the two work together to eliminate would-be murderers? Or will Jihyeon's very ex…

Become a Chetamja! Turn your rage into a weapon that defends the kingdom!
When young Gwiyeong loses his family in a brutal Jurchen raid, he swears to hunt down every last one of them. His skill in battle soon catches the attention of King Sejong, who offers him a chance to join Chetamja—an elite force of secret agents serving as the king’s eyes and ears in the north.
Now, alongside his…

entries.t: What a Bountiful Harvest, Demon Lord!
entries.d: Who was that guy that once said, “An army marches on its stomach”? When hapless agricultural science student Jangcheol Kim starts playing the fantasy MMORPG “Paladins of Blood” to escape the stress of school life, he never imagined he would end up inside the game, much less as its final boss. How can a ruthless demon overlord win over his subjects? Perhaps with potatoes.

Weisshorn looks like a sugar-coated dreamland of smiling mascots, endless parades, and a Leader who loves you. But for Nel, it’s a lie. Branded a terrorist, she joins a rebel gang to tear it all down. The deeper she digs, the weirder it gets–strange visions, ghosts, and secrets buried for a reason. Some dreams are designed to keep you asleep. But if breaking free means letting go of ev…

Zed, a former MMA champion, wakes up in the body of a scrawny prisoner in a fantasy world. Reborn as a member of the once-feared Arahan family, he’s trapped inside a brutal magical internment camp. With no spells at his disposal, Zed trains his body to become a living weapon. He escapes the prison with his only ally Riu, a sharp-witted inmate. Now hunted by both a ruthless warden and a noble…

After losing his memories in an accident, Eun Jo transfers to a new school, convinced he's a model student—quiet, kind, and hardworking. But when he sees his classmate Bom being bullied, something in him snaps. His instincts take over—and so do his fists. As Eun rises against the school’s cruel hierarchy, he starts to wonder: Who was he before? And why does Bom feel so familiar? …

24-year-old web novel writer Yeong Won isn’t interested in love, but she can’t help admiring her roommate’s handsome boyfriend, Mu-il Shin. But Mu-il suddenly dies, and Yeong receives a mysterious package containing a robot vacuum. The vacuum introduces itself as an AI copy of Mu-il, and claims that he was murdered. Now, Yeong must navigate life with a digital version of the one …

Love comes in when you least expect it… or does it? Falling for your best friend, your high school crush, your crush’s teammate, or even your bully... Wait that can’t be right! Can it? 

Well that’s the case for Melisa Neal, a shy aspiring artist that just came back to her hometown and her old childhood bully Trent Springs that seems intent on making amends. Are these inte…

Mysterious black circles have started appearing all over the world, and whoever falls in doesn't come back out. Then one day, a black circle swallows an entire school and everyone in it, turning it into a twisted maze of nightmares. Will Doyun and his classmates find a way out?

Dedicated to making up for the sins of her past life, Song Jihyun devotes herself to mastering the art of surgery. Despite her efforts to atone, she dies in an unexpected plane crash. Or does she…? Waking up in her old body, that of the emperor’s consort, Elise De Clarence, she resolves herself to not squander this life like she did before.

It's a rude insult when lowly and headstrong servant Edna comes to marry Duke Eli, instead of the noble daughter he expected. But the ambitious maid hides an even bigger secret behind her obvious ruse -- one that could change the kingdom's very history. Can the two find freedom, redemption, and love -- without drawing their swords on each other? Based on the hit novel.

When Jaejeong Shin’s dad rents out part of their house, he loses his favorite room, and gains a grudge. The tenants? A single mom and her daughter, Arin Woo. Things spiral when Jaejeong discovers their parents are having an affair. And, turns out, Arin just learned about their affair too. Bound by this dirty secret, Jaejeong and Arin grow closer, even as resentment simmers. As secrets pile u…

entries.t: I Became the Duke’s Male Servant
entries.d:
In the original story, Roselia was a maid in the duke’s household, used as a mere pawn in his schemes before being executed by the crown prince after being framed as a traitor.
But this Roselia is different. The heroine, now in the body of the doomed maid from the novel and fully aware of how the story ends, is determined to change Roselia’s fate—disguising herself as a man to av…

The light that fell from the heavens shared a gift with its creations, seeking connection. But humans and their dark hearts would corrupt the very essence of the gift, turning their desires and themselves into twisted, misshapen monstrosities.
Yet, there was hope. 
Heroes would arise--heroes, who would not only stare into the abyss but fight the horrors in it.
The gift was golden, but darkness fes…

The Holy Sword is the only weapon that can defeat the Demon King… and Knight John Forkinstrong lost it. From the desolate Forgotten Fortress to the eldritch hellscape of the Super-Huge Cursed Ravine That You Can Never Leave Once You Enter, John has searched high and low for decades, but to no avail. And the only thing that continues to fuel John's unwavering willpower... is the fact that it…

A beautiful and successful news anchor, Yeojin's life looks perfect from the outside. But in reality, she's trapped in an unhappy marriage. Not only did her husband have an affair with her close coworker, but he also murdered her parents and stole their company. Yeojin thought her life was over, but when she opened her eyes, she found herself back on her wedding day. Watching her husband and his m…

In a world where werewolves live among humans in secret, Ji-u Han, a detective agency owner and a powerful werewolf, crosses paths with Yuseung Cheon, a famous actor, when he “accidentally” hits her with his car. And when they run into each other again “by chance,” one thing becomes clear to Ji-u: She must have him —whatever that may entail.
Ji-u wants Yuseung’s…

After discovering her "friend" Minchae was only using her to clean up her own image, bullied high schooler Seyo’s life takes a dramatic turn when an accident leaves her in the body of a beautiful coma patient named Kkotbi! The deity responsible for the body swap offers her a deal: fulfill Kkotbi's destiny by becoming an idol within a year or lose everything. Now Seyo must learn the ropes of …

When Airi is reincarnated as a noble’s daughter, she expects an easy life—until her family goes bankrupt and she’s forced to work as a maid for the Grand Duke. While chasing a young lord, she stumbles into a hidden chamber and is trapped for what feels like 100 days. But when she escapes, twelve years have passed, and the world is at war with monstrous beasts. Now, Airi must navi…

Reincarnated as the heroine of a dark fantasy novel who meets a tragic end, Ibelin is determined to avoid her fate. After being forced into a marriage with the cold and indifferent Dyffrin, she resolves that, no matter what, she would divorce him in two years, taking a hefty alimony with her in the process. However, as she begins to put her plans to take control of her destiny into action, control…

Ju-in Jeon, a depressed 17-year-old, is offered a ticket to heaven in exchange for her body. But, 13 years later, she wakes up—not in paradise, but in her 30-year-old body… and in the middle of a scam. Stuck for 108 days while heaven's agent searches for the fraudster, Ju-in crosses paths with Do-gwon Ju, another soul-scam victim in the same situation. But what happens when the souls …

Unseon Kang’s master has been killed before his very eyes – and now he is the only one alive who knows the secrets that his master wrote about. Anyone he meets could be an enemy who will stop at nothing to gain those secrets. Now he must try to navigate a world in which he can trust nobody while trying to obtain martial arts skills that will help him grow stronger. Will he be able to k…

To cover her father’s hospital bills, Jiwan agrees to become Taeseong's legal wife for three years; a marriage of convenience with one condition, one billion won once the contract ends. Bound by strict terms, the contract prohibits any contact throughout their marriage.

Three years pass, and two weeks before the contract expires— Taeseong suddenly shows up at her door convinced that J…

In a world where adventurers raid dungeons for fame and fortune, Nagi is stuck as a lowly porter – overlooked, mistreated, and considered expendable. But armed with a mysterious magic bag and quick wits, Nagi begins to challenge the brutal hierarchy from within. Can he rise above betrayal, dangerous monsters, and a corrupt system – or will this ruthless world discard him like the bagga…

A state-of-the-art operating room with pristine surgical equipment? No can do; just a rusty bone saw in front of a jeering crowd for you! Sound like a waking nightmare? Well, that’s the best that the finest 19th century British medicine has to offer Taepyeong Kim, a young student from Joseon who retains the memory of his past life as a surgeon in modern-day Korea. For Taepyeong, London&rsquo…

entries.t: From Old Country Bumpkin to Master Swordsman
entries.d: Middle-aged Beryl Gardenant has only ever accomplished one thing: running a humble sword-fighting dojo in the quiet countryside. But when he’s paid a visit by his former pupil, Allucia, he discovers that she has become an elite commander—and she’s hardly the only ex-student who’s a renowned warrior! Now forced by Allucia to become a special instructor to the strongest order…

entries.t: Regressed, but the World Didn’t End
entries.d:
Humanity’s last hope just got a second chance… and a mountain of debt.
Dohyeok, the champion of humankind, is sent back in time to stop the apocalypse. He then pours his time, money, and soul into preparing for an alien invasion that never comes. Now chased by creditors instead of aliens, Dohyeok turns to game streaming to repay his debt. Follow the ex-hero-turned-streamer as he hacks…

Ajin Bae suddenly dives into Dear Dane, the world’s top MMORPG, using her brother’s account—who just happens to be the master of its number one guild. Tasked with keeping her identity secret, she tries to protect his legacy, but things spiral when she’s mistaken for a creep hitting on Bloomie, a popular female player who’s secretly a male idol. Trying to clear things …

Once a year on a cold midwinter night in the Empire of Hartan, a fortress of frost appears, revealing the resting place of a blue-eyed demon said to grant any wish – for a price. When Princess Estelle of Hartan flees her abusive imperial family, she is encounters the otherworldly Frost Fort and makes a pact with Satael, the blue-eyed demon of legend. Pledging her body and soul to him, Estell…

entries.t: The Genius Swordsman of Mount Hua
entries.d: After being ambushed by the Demonic Cult, Goheon Dok and Hyeonjo, his close friend from Mount Hua, are cornered and on the verge of losing their lives. Before they're both killed, Hyeonjo hands Goheon the Plum Blossom Spirit Beads, a sacred relic of Mount Hua that causes Goheon to take possession of the body of Muhwi, an apprentice of Hyeonjo. Now, as a Senior Disciple of Mount Hua, Goheon Dok mus…

Binge-reading my favorite romantasy novel is my one and only solace after late-night shifts at my part-time job. I was just reading my novel while walking home from yet another long shift, when suddenly a truck…! Huh? Delivery truck driver Taekjin’s struggle to return back to Korea after waking up in a strange world begins!

The Trauma Center series returns!
Uncover the gripping prequel to Trauma Center: Golden Hour and follow the emotional journey of Dr. Ganghyeok Baek. Every scar, every choice, every life saved... his story starts here. Witness the making of a medical legend as he takes his first steps into the chaos and courage of trauma care.

Burned out from work, Yeonseul’s long-awaited vacation takes a disastrous turn when she finds herself stranded on an island. Her only company? A maddeningly handsome stranger, infuriating as he is irresistible–but with survival forcing them together, sparks fly and an impulsive marriage marked by a night neither can forget transforms their relationship into something rather intimate. B…

After a messy breakup with a trashy ex forces Ihyeon Seon to take a three-year-long break from college, the last thing she wants to do upon her not-so-inconspicuous return is to dive straight into another relationship. But then comes Chanu Nam, a notorious bad boy who finds himself having a vested interest in Ihyeon. And suddenly, what was supposed to be a low-key senior year is looking like it's …

Blessed be the devout who remain chaste among the tainted. 
A pious young debutante of the Kingdom of Brandt, Elke Eberhardt prays each day as she vies for the sacred title of Pontifex, which grants authority over the nation’s faith. Unfortunately for Elke, fate has other, crueler plans—as she catches the eye of Sir Reiner Mikhel, a notorious womanizer who has seduced countless noblewo…

Minu Seo, a struggling nobody, never thought he'd inherit anything, especially not from the mother who abandoned him. However, what he received was beyond anything he could have imagined... A kindergarten for divine beasts! Will Minu be able to look after these magical children as their new teacher?

All Seong-a Myeong wants to do is spend her life playing video games. Unfortunately, after defeating a streamer in an online game and taking his money, she realizes that he is actually a boy in her class named Hanjun Kang, who also happens to be a terrifying delinquent! Determined to keep her identity a secret, she decides to request a class transfer, only to run into Tae-ui An, another classmate …

Set against the backdrop of a wintry Seoul, Winter Breeze tells a story of second chances, hope, and the unexpected warmth that can bloom even in the coldest seasons. Two years after their fleeting encounter at Seoul Station, Haena is reunited with Dohwa at a newly opened photo studio tucked away in her quiet neighborhood, and finds herself drawn to the mysterious photographer she hasn’t bee…

In a world where you must steal or be stolen, kill or be killed, Ray, an orphan from the 50th sector, possesses the unique ability to see mana in the form of colors. However, despite the colorful sparks that fill the world around him, his existence has been numb detachment, completely devoid of emotions. But when a life-altering event shatters the cold, unfeeling life he once knew, Ray's journey m…

After losing their mother to an illness at a young age, two young and talented alchemists, brothers Edward and Alphonse Elric, attempt the forbidden act of human transmutation to bring her back. But little did they know there was a heavy price to pay for breaking the ultimate taboo in alchemy.
Edward loses his left leg after the transmutation fails, and his only remaining family, Alphonse, is take…

entries.t: Why You Shouldn't Enter a Haunted House
entries.d: Hyeon may seem like a normal high schooler, but he can see and interact with spirits. While he tries to live a quiet life, everything changes when he meets Jeseung, a classmate obsessed with live-streaming in haunted houses. Soon, Hyeon finds himself visiting eerie places and uncovering a sinister mystery--someone is manipulating spirits, promising to bring them back to life. As he confronts dange…

Idel Fleure was born without a scent in a noble family where fragrance defines one’s lineage, causing her to be ostracized.
She escapes a forced marriage by being accepted into Euphiter Imperial University, but finds herself bound in another marriage– one to Archduke Chaeron, who is drawn to her scent that only he can smell. Chaeron proposes a contractual marriage, and agrees to take h…

"I want a divorce."
The arrogant Christoph believed Marianne would eventually return. That she'd left home on a whim. After all, the facts had always said he was right.
Well, he couldn't have been more wrong. Filled with regret, he tries to bring Marianne back, but she refuses to change her mind.
Can Christoph earn Marianne's forgiveness and win her heart again?

Harang is a rising star in women’s handball… until she isn’t. Unexpectedly sidelined by a devastating shoulder injury, Harang tries to return to her daily grind as a student. But life has a way of throwing huge curveballs, and she finds herself a part of the women’s futsal team at her high school along with passionate, determined teammates. Women’s national league, h…

entries.t: My Bias Gets on the Last Train
entries.d:
Every night, Yeo-un takes the last train home—same route, same time, same routine. But one thing keeps catching his eye: a girl with a guitar and a presence that lingers in his mind. When a shared love for the indie band Long Afternoon sparks a conversation, their late-night encounters begin to turn into something more.
But Hae-in isn’t just another fan—she’s the voice behi…

Hyeol Yu is a third-rate warrior feared more for his menacing appearance than his actual skills. Branded by false rumors and endless misunderstandings, he has long been an outcast in the world of martial arts. But everything changes when Seolhwa, the woman he once vowed his life to, reappears before him as a true martial arts master. From that moment on, Hyeol is thrust into chaos, his name weavin…

If love is the ultimate prize, then the perils of courtship are the necessary trials and tribulations one must endure in its pursuit. It is a blessing for the society debutantes of London, then, that Cupid’s arrow should be guided by the dainty hand of Miss Laura Pendleton, granddaughter of Countess Pendleton and the city’s finest matchmaker. When Laura’s self-ascribed duties cal…

Ajin is a carefree high school girl interested only in baking and is a loyal friend who values her bonds above all. Despite her ordinary appearance, she garners the interest of Junu, one of the most handsome guys at her school, adding a newfound excitement and unpredictability into her life.
Will they be able to overcome the jealous manipulations of others and realize their feelings for each other…

entries.t: The Masters of Heaven and Earth
entries.d:
The tales of the heavens are no different from those on earth.
Tongmi just wants to live an ordinary, peaceful life. However, with new kinds of thugs appearing left and right every day, it seems like the world has other plans for him – plans that involve him becoming a legend.

Hoseok is a tiger who wants to make and sell cute desserts in peace. While he was once a member of a shady syndicate, he makes the decision to wash his hands of that life and instead follow his dream of opening his own dessert shop! But this new life isn’t as easy as it sounds. Can Hoseok overcome the prejudices his neighbors have against him and make his dream come true? A slice-of-life sto…

On her wedding day, Hana Gu realizes her relationship lacks love and flees the ceremony. During her escapade, she runs into her ex-boyfriend, Gawi Nam who helps her by using his mysterious ability to time travel into the past. Determined to erase her unwanted marriage, she uses this ability to try and change her fate, but the future proves less malleable than expected. Amid repeated failures, she …

Betrayed by his guild and defeated by a top player, Hyrkan loses everything. Before he can get revenge, a fatal accident ends his life—only for him to wake up years in the past, back at the start of Warlord. Now, with his memories intact, he’s determined to rise to the top alone. But in a game where power means everything, can he truly survive without any allies? The Emperor of Solo Pl…

Top Korean hunter Siu 'The Rabid Hound' Min defeated the Demon Lord with his disciples, only to be trapped in a monster-filled otherworld for 100 years.
However, a century of struggles did not break Siu—it drove him to break his limits instead.
Now, he returns to Earth with Pred, his mysterious partner, only to learn that his name and legacy have been erased, along with his disciples’.…

Gabriel appears to be a shy, quiet teenager but beneath the surface, he is a psychopath struggling to suppress his violent urges in order to fit into society. Everything changes when he and his classmates are caught in a mysterious storm and transported into a brutal arena where survival means fighting to the death. As chaos erupts, Gabriel faces an impossible choice: continue hiding his true natu…

Queen Clara of Balladene is in a tough spot! After her sudden coronation takes her from carefree student to queen overnight, she faces the impossible task of holding court with excessively judgement lords. But a new face appears in court, albeit behind a jingling jester’s mask, and this handsome jester has a proposal: use the power of goofs and gossip to sway the lords. With few allies in th…

The Grim Reaper centers his whole existence on collecting mortal souls, waiting to be reborn into his next reincarnation. It is the haunting of a lone spirit that insists the Reaper remember his past life instead... But the Reaper would rather not remember. He wants to move on. Though maybe the only way forward is to embrace the secrets that the past may hold.

Following Kuvira’s defeat, Korra can finally carry out her Avatar duties and focus on her budding relationship with Asami… or maybe not. In this new batch of adventures, Team Avatar - Korra, Asami, Mako, and Bolin - are tasked with keeping the peace in Republic City as new enemies arise, political conflicts unleash, and new emotions surface. In Turf Wars, can the new triad leader, Tok…

Traveling near the edge of the Black Forest, monster hunter Geralt meets a widowed fisherman whose dead and murderous wife resides in an eerie mansion known as the House of Glass—a labyrinth of endless rooms with nothing to fill them, and horror around every corner. An anthology series following the adventures of Geralt of Rivia, the legendary witcher from the critically acclaimed video game…

Explore the depths of Night City through the interconnected lives of cyberpunks, mercs, gangs, corpos, and more! In this megalopolis of corporate power, crime, and corruption, survival is an everyday struggle. Based on the hit game by CD PROJEKT RED, experience the dangerous, yet vibrant world of Cyberpunk 2077 where humanity and future technology converge in these intense action-packed stories.

Crazy Dave—the babbling-yet-brilliant inventor and top notch neighborhood defender—helps his niece Patrice and the young adventurer Nate Timely fend off zombie invasions that threaten to overrun their peaceful town of Neighborville! Their only hope against Dr. Zomboss’s hordes and hapless plans is a brave army of chomping, squashing, and pea-shooting plants!

Noah Brown has a gift for fighting. Unfortunately, punching things doesn't pay his bills. At least, that was the case until he dies and an Eldritch god finds his soul. The strange encounter brings him to a new world, summoned by bloody cultists. He’s got nothing but the shirt on his back and a strange item of unknown power he isn’t yet sure how to use. If he wants to survive, maybe eve…
Experience the whimsical, tragic, and sometimes haunting backstories of the party of misfits who would become the Mighty Nein. Created in collaboration with the cast of Critical Role.

Haechan dreams of becoming a hero, saving Korea from the deadly Calamities. But as a powerless guard, he is seen as a weakling. That is, until he meets Miro, a mysterious girl who offers him immense power in exchange for his help in destroying the sacred Seal Talismans—the true source of the Calamities’ wrath. Now, Haechan must embark on a dangerous mission to free the world from its t…

Doesn’t every child dream of a world without grown-ups? But when a deadly virus wipes out everyone over the age of twenty, reality proves to be far more sinister than a childhood fantasy.
By the time No-eul turns eight, he is already familiar with the virus and the mysterious monsters that roam the land. When his mother passes away and his village comes under threat, he sets out on a journey…

Ever feel like the legal system's punishment just isn't enough? Taepil Kim knows that feeling better than anyone. Ever since he was slapped with ten years in prison for retaliating against two burglars who killed his wife and left his son in a coma, he stopped having faith in the kind of justice the judicial system could bring. But one day, he’s given the opportunity to become a Punisher-- a…

DJ just wants a simple life with his friends, until a chance run-in with a witch named Superfish leaves him accidentally bonded to a powerful witch’s core. Now a walking target for any malicious creature, DJ finds himself under Superfish’s reluctant protection as they search for a cure before it's too late… assuming the two can get along to make it to the other side.

Humans have left Earth, leaving behind a pack of dogs who have been waiting for their master's return for years. Most had long since moved on, but a small pup with no name is still holding onto hope that he would one day meet his humans.

Based on a Korean folktale, two very different women find themselves making the same wish - to leave this world behind. One is Shim Chong, a young beggar living off the kindness of others to support herself and her blind father. The other is the bride-to-be of old Chancellor Jang, sold off to him for the sake of her family. When Shim Chong rescues this new bride from the river, their relationship …

Suit up! Jian is an Italian soccer league benchwarmer who needs to convince his childhood friend that he's a star player. A lucky goal or two might do the trick, but how long can he keep up the ruse? Unless, unbeknownst to him, Jian really is a genius...

Remember when high school drama felt way more serious than it really was? Well, in Taeyang City, there’s a little more on the line than gossip and hurt feelings. It’s more about loose teeth and broken jaws! With every high school in town ruled by a gang of hard-knock delinquents, the top dogs fight for dominance and the elusive title of “Myeongwang,” the greatest high schoo…

Giju is highly competent, but when it comes to love, she always seems to choose the wrong guy.
This time, she thought things would be different. But again her faith is betrayed, and during a heated argument, she ends up falling down a flight of stairs.
When she awakens in the hospital, she starts seeing suspicious ‘relationship reviews’ of others!
‘Love reviews written by their f…

entries.t: Regression of the Yong Clan Heir
entries.d: Hwalin Yong, once the shattered heir of a fallen martial sect, is thrust back in time-- but he isn’t alone. A monstrous darkness lingers at the edges of his mind, constantly whispering, waiting to claim him. Can Hwalin resist its pull, or will he surrender to the shadow? As the battle within intensifies, he uncovers a dormant power that could reshape his destiny and the fate of his sect.

entries.t: I Will Protect My Tyrant Dad!
entries.d: Sien is your average adorable kid living in the country with her kind dad... or so she thought. It turns out her dad is actually an heir of a grand duke banished from an evil family! Sien will do anything to protect her innocent dad from the wickedness that awaits them. Join Sien on her adventure to keep her tyrant dad safe!

entries.t: There Are No Bad Warriors in This World
entries.d: Hyeonseok Choi finally becomes the undisputed heavyweight MMA champion of the world, but gets hit by a truck, and dies. A fairy, Rahel, appears and convinces him to fight as a hero in the afterlife, but accidentally sends him to the side of the demons. Stuck in the demon world, he sweet talks his way into positions of power, but slowly discovers this battle between good and evil isn't as clearcut …

Welcome to Hoseon: The land of myths and spirits, where monsters take human form and exorcists come with assault rifles! For wandering spirit hunter Gal Park, sniffing out and dispatching disgruntled monsters and spirits is all part of the job – no matter if they prey on the wicked or the innocent alike. But everything becomes a little more complicated when he crosses paths with his former c…

entries.t: In the Spirit of the Law
entries.d: After a mysterious accident on a scorching summer day, high school student Jaehun wakes up to a startling discovery - his soul is now sharing his body with that of an enigmatic ascetic. Over the next three years, Jaehun adjusts to life with his unexpected companion while undergoing rehabilitation. Just as he begins to settle into this strange new reality, he faces a pivotal moment: choosing his pa…

Many people dream of being reborn as a princess in another world. And Hari, an ordinary woman, finds herself in that exact situation… or so she thought. Instead of flowy hair and the beautiful face of a princess, she has stubby limbs and shiny black toe beans. Yup, she’s been reincarnated in a palace in another world as a dog. And a talking one, at that! Will she be able to survive as…

After three failed marriages, Archduke Theo de Phoenix has long accepted that love simply isn’t in the cards for him. After all, who could love a war-hardened monster like him? So when his fourth bride arrives, he greets her covered in blood, gives her a shabby attic for a room, and keeps his distance. Surely, this one will run too. But Yuelina is not like the others. To Theo’s disbeli…

entries.t: I'm a Villainess, but I Won't Live Like One
entries.d: Bianca is just another noble lady with a simple dream: to marry into a dukedom and enjoy a life of luxury. But everything changes when she stumbles upon a book—one that casts her as the villainess, doomed to stand in the way of her real-life fiancé’s love story with a commoner girl. As Bianca realizes the book accurately depicts her own fate, she refuses to accept her tragic end…

On the night of her eighteenth birthday, Faith Williams meets the boy of her nightmares — Death himself. 

Unbeknownst to her, Death has come to collect on a forgotten promise Faith made long ago. But when she refuses to comply, Faith's reality twist into something unrecognizable.  

Torn between Death’s dark pull and her growing connection to David Star— a golden boy with secret…

When girls at Aguefort Adventuring Academy go missing, six heroes who meet in detention band together to investigate their new high school for clues. This gang of self-anointed “Bad Kids” sets off on a wild journey, encountering vicious corn chowder and debaucherous wizards, among other perils that threaten their lives and the world they know and love. Based on the hit Dimension 20 sho…

George Takei has captured hearts and minds worldwide with his captivating stage presence and outspoken commitment to equal rights. But long before he braved new frontiers in Star Trek, he woke up as a four-year-old boy to find his own birth country at war with his father's—and their entire family forced from their home into an uncertain future. In a stunning graphic memoir, Takei revisits hi…

The King of the Monsters is back in this compendium collecting three series: Legends, In Hell, and Rage Across Time! In a world where monsters roam freely, some stories have been lost to time... until NOW! In Legends, the kaiju of Godzilla's fearsome rogues gallery get the spotlight. Featuring Anguirus, Rodan, Titanosaurus, Hedorah, and Kumonga! Then, meet Godzilla's greatest adversary of all time…

The evil genius Dr. Eggman has been foiled — but the work of Sonic the Hedgehog isn’t over yet! In the aftermath of the latest epic battle, rogue robots continue to attack small villages around the world. In order to defeat them, Sonic will need the help of his friends Tails, Knuckles, and Amy, along with some new and surprising allies. This new collection features the Blue Blur like y…

Locke & Key tells a sprawling tale of magic and family, legacy and grief, good and evil. Acclaimed suspense novelist and New York Times best-selling author Joe Hill (The Fireman, Heart-Shaped Box) has created a gripping story of dark fantasy and wonder—with astounding artwork from Gabriel Rodriguez—that, like the doors of Keyhouse, will transform all who open it.

entries.t: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: The Last Ronin
entries.d: Who is the Last Ronin? In a future, battle-ravaged New York City, a lone surviving Turtle embarks on a seemingly hopeless mission seeking justice for the family he lost.

entries.t: Beneath the Trees Where Nobody Sees
entries.d:
Don’t. Murder. The locals.
This is small-town serial killer, upstanding citizen, and adorable brown bear Samantha Strong’s cardinal rule. After all, there’s a sea of perfectly ripe potential victims in the big city just beyond the forest, and when you’ve worked as hard as Sam to build a cozy life and a thriving business in a community surrounded by friendly fellow animal fo…

When Kieran meets his new classmate, Mason Kane, he bristles with an unexplainable disdain. Soon it becomes apparent why: Mason is a werewolf. But when a fight turns into a sudden kiss that neither expects, Kieran's feelings for Mason turn to attraction in an instant. None of it makes sense - vampires and werewolves are supposed to be mortal enemies, so why does Kieran find Mason so irresistible?

Once the greatest mage and Grand Magus of the White Tower, Oscar Sage dies in a war against The Demon Emperor—only to awaken twenty years later as the disgraced noble, Oscar Crusian. The once-mighty White Tower lies in ruins, and rival factions hold control over military and resources. With his mana circuits sealed and former allies now enemies, Oscar must rebuild the White Tower, seek venge…

entries.t: I Decide My Fate, Your Highness
entries.d: Betrayed by her family and sentenced to die as an experiment, Phillie Lutner awakens the Tarot Cards of Fate, a Divine Relic with the power to rewrite time. Determined to reclaim her life, she uses their magic to escape her former fiancé, outsmart her scheming half-sister, and claim her rightful place as heir to the House of Lutner. But as she uncovers a dark plot surrounding the Relics, on…

Raised as brothers in an orphanage, Bawoo and Joseph take opposite paths—Joseph becoming a priest and Bawoo becoming an underground fighting champion. However, when Joseph awakens as the great demon Lucifer and massacres the residents of their orphanage, their brotherly relationship turns into one fueled by revenge. In order to bring Joseph to justice, Bawoo sets off on a relentless pursuit …

Find love and…500 million won?!
Three women are about to take on a special challenge to escape their “forever alone” status.
The “airhead” Jurim, the “trash collector” Seona, and the “devout Christian” Chaeyul are ready to compete for both money and love for the first time ever.
Who will take it all?

Yeon finds herself as an extra in her own novel. To make the most out of the bizarre event, she goes on a quest to find her handsome male lead Chang. However, who she finds is none other than the younger, frail version of the antagonist Bi. Yeon finds that the "antagonist" Bi is being pushed through the narrative of a villain -- can she stay by his side through it all?

entries.t: The Formerly Number One Ranked Rookie
entries.d: After learning that he can make money by clearing a full-dive VR game called Prophecy Online, Ray Endo bets his life on the game in hopes of striking it rich. When he successfully clears the game, it suddenly announces its shutdown. However, days later, the world is on the brink of destruction by the same monsters from Prophecy Online. As the only person who has cleared the game and knows its ins …

There’s a convenience store that feels uncomfortable but somehow keeps drawing you in. One day, a new night-shift part-timer appears at the small convenience store -- his rugged looks fill everyone with unease, but soon he brings about a refreshing change to this small convenience store.
He helps not only his coworkers but also customers, resolving their worries and troubles. Who is this mys…

What if your future self appeared to guide you?
Haruto is a magicless stooge in a world of mages, but everything changes when his future self appears and alters his destiny. However, with great power comes great challenges. Thrust into the spotlight, Haruto must face relentless trials while following the guidance of the person he is destined to become.
But one question remains—why has his fu…

Hari Jeon is a high school student with a heart condition. One day, she is struck by a curse that causes her to zap everything and everyone around her whenever her heart races for Jeong-won, her secret crush.
Yura Baek, a brash and sharp-tongued classmate who mysteriously knows about her curse, offers her a deal—he’ll help her keep it under control if she lets him use it.
Can Hari find…

entries.t: The Genius Wants an Ordinary Life
entries.d:
A man who has everything and yet nothing.
The only thing successful corporate executive Jinhyeok Son ever really wanted was an ordinary life with a beloved family, a desire arising from the tragic death of his parents when he was a child. This all changes after he finds himself back in his nine-year-old body after an accident -- to a time when his parents are still alive, to the very life he had l…
In a world filled with monsters and magic, a cat and a hunter named Hawk begin their adventure with different purposes but with the same goal in mind: to protect something precious and seek revenge.
The public bathroom at the mall is haunted... but no one has noticed?! Easily distracted but determined to achieve her goals, this ghost girl will have to work hard to give people a good fright!

Fame, fortune, and rabid fans - America’s new favorite pastime guarantees it all. Live assassinations funded by the masses, brought to you by the thriving entertainment industry of Murder Club! Fresh out of retirement, veteran Holly Mountainside needs to get back in the game, and country boy Bartholomew Greaves, who has never touched a weapon in his life, needs a job. Can this eclectic tag-t…

Primrose Academy is a prestigious school attended by future gods, angels, and familiars. For the Angel of Death, Azrael, there’s only one goal in his final year: to graduate. With the help of his friends—and a pact to make the most of their last year—what could possibly go wrong? Well, aside from someone at school discovering a secret that could get Azrael expelled.

Stranded in the middle of the desert with no food, water, or purpose, Raissa's luck turns around when Esther, a djinn who can grant temporary wishes, falls into her lap (literally). Teaming up to find a legendary artifact that can permanently grant any wish asked of it, no matter how impossible, the two set off on an adventure to fulfill their deepest desires: Esther to become human, and Raissa to…

Being a shonen protagonist is a pain! Oryn avoids mobsters, monsters, and mayhem to achieve his true dream: living a completely unexceptional life. Unfortunately, his villain—volatile, dangerous, annoying Zef—can’t seem to let him go. If he can’t change his role, Oryn wonders if he might be able to change his genre instead… and what could be better than romance?

Yejun is a private investigator who specializes in catching cheating partners. Love is the last thing on his mind.
But when he's assigned a cupid tasked to find Yejun a soulmate, the two are forced into an uneasy partnership. They don’t get along, but as they work together, they begin to uncover darker truths about each other, and what it really means to fall in love.

Amber’s tarot-reading business might be a flop, but it does lead the dangerously charming and very real seer Gareth right to her tent. Invited to a secret society of witches who do readings for the rich and influential, Amber follows Gareth into the coven’s prestigious Gallery. There, she finds herself in a whole new world of nature defying powers... and crime.

Trapped inside the world of "Praesepe in a Cage", Juyeon Yun becomes the game’s female protagonist, Praesepe, and must navigate a tangled web of romance and danger to escape. After completing all five male protagonists' storylines, she’s thrust into "secret mode," where everything changes. The characters she thought she knew are acting strangely, and Praesepe begins uncovering secrets&…

James Rayner has long endured the Council’s oppressive rule over the society of other creatures—but everything changes when he meets Kenta, a spirited werewolf working at a quiet convenience store. What begins as an unlikely friendship turns into something deeper, and the mark they share awakens an ancient power the Council both fears and covets. As love and destiny collide, James must…

Living in a contaminated zone under the constant threat of the Crimson Cloud and its acidic Red Rain, all Mani wants is to protect and provide for his younger siblings. Thankfully, as one of the few who can survive the Red Rain, a 'Bleacher', he has been able to do that so far. However, when faced with the very weight of the world coming for him and his siblings, what will his soul drive him to do…

Riku and Cherry have always hated each other. So how are they supposed to co-parent an egg together? They're totally scrambled. Forced together for their senior project, sparks fly when these two boys try to keep both their egg baby--and their feelings--uncracked.
Serious Ann has no love life, instead choosing to focus on her career as a graphic designer. But when a project brings her into happy-go-lucky Libby's bar, will that change?

In a world of magic and demons, Willow - the most powerful witch of her generation - has only one goal: discover the truth behind her mother's death. The most likely suspects? The royal family. So when Willow is given the rare opportunity to mentor the Crown Prince, she eagerly does so. But little did she know the secrets - and passion - she and the prince would uncover...

What is Jasha's worse offense: that he's magicless? Or that he's a boy? Adopted into an all-girls academy, his classmates - all aspiring to the Sisterhood and its White Magic - are eager to remind him his faults daily. Eager to fit in, growing up makes Jasha only grow more desperate - perhaps desperate enough to break the Academy's one cardinal rule...

Dan is a lone wolf... literally! A werewolf with no home, that is until Marina mistakes him for a dog and brings him into her dog shelter. Hoping to secretly pay her back, Dan works there as a volunteer, but did he bite off more than he can chew? Now he has to contend with vets, unruly dogs, and the frazzled Marina herself! Oh, and did we mention he turns back into a wolf whenever he sees a moon?

After illegally sneaking outside the city boundaries, Slade becomes unlikely friends with Calico, a boy from the outer slums who the city deems "defective" Can they stay together when the outside world is full of deadly 'haze', and the only safe haven wants them apart?
The relationship between a monster and the paladin sent to kill her.

"Never sail into the sea when your heart bears the weight of sorrow," Jaena, burdened by the pain of a recent breakup, stumbles upon a mystical encounter that changes her life forever. As the deep sea threatens to swallow her whole, an alluring beauty emerges from the depths, followed by a kiss that ignites a bond between two worlds — that of a human and an annoying, flirtatious siren.

When Jas jokingly claims he’s dating “Art,” his words spark a school-wide misunderstanding that flips Art’s life upside down. The rumor costs Art his chance to get closer to his crush Julienne, who just so happens to also be Jas’s sister. To make things right, Jas proposes a deal: if they pretend to date, he’ll help Art win over Julienne. As they navigate fake c…

entries.t: The Princess is Now the Duke
entries.d: Princess Amara fakes her own death to escape an unwanted marriage and reinvents herself as Duke Alexander—the perfect suitor to marry Lady Elaine, the woman she truly loves. But Elaine, unaware of the truth, is set to marry Prince Edgars—Amara’s own brother. When the Emperor declares a tournament for Elaine’s hand and the throne, Alexander must outfight rival suitors and wi…

What if your “true self” jumped out of the mirror and got mixed up in your life?
That’s what happens to “Me”, an insecure trans guy, when he meets his flamboyant “True” self, determined to teach “Me” to love himself. Follow them and their friends on a journey filled with comedy, overthinking and nerdiness!

entries.t: Surviving as the Crown Prince's Childhood Friend
entries.d: When Ella finds a sickly young boy suffering from a mysterious illness in a cave, she brings him home, only for her to discover a special healing power that helps him recover. Six years later, Carl has grown into a striking young man, but to Ella, he remains like a brother… or so she thinks. Though childhood friends, what Ella doesn’t know, is that Carl is the lost crown prince of the…

A young aspiring chef suddenly finds himself in a world of war, dragons, and magic. These two worlds couldn’t be further apart... or could they? 
Who says you can’t open a restaurant in a fantasy realm? I mean, what could possibly go wrong?
A perfect series for fantasy, magic, and food lovers.

entries.t: This Wasn’t in My Adoption Plan!
entries.d:
I spent a decade cleaning up after Duke Havenik Brauno’s mess only to be murdered by him?
Reincarnated as Aerin Brauno, an illegitimate child of the Brauno family, she’s horrified to find her adoptive father is none other than the man who killed her. This time, Aerin refuses to let him control her fate. Armed with the knowledge from her past life, she’s determined to escape his g…

The martial arts world's most dangerous mastermind finds herself reborn in the weakest possible form: a tiny toddler and holy monarch’s successor, destined to die young. But Danye Jin didn't survive centuries of martial arts intrigue just to accept defeat in diapers. Armed with ancient techniques and disarming baby charm, this mysteriously capable little girl is turning imminent death into t…

After suffering her own heartbreak, Melissa devoted her life to creating peoples’ perfect weddings. Her professional and emotional worlds collide spectacularly when a dream client walks into her office, only for Melissa to learn that the bride-to-be’s fiancé is none other than the man she once planned to marry. Will she subtly sabotage the one who broke her heart or will the for…

Jinwol Ma, better known in the martial realm as the ‘Mad Demon’, once stained the earth with blood in his pursuit to become the pinnacle of all living things.
That was until his final battle with the Five Supreme Masters, where the leader of the Fire Dragon sect sealed him away using the Demon-Sealing Sword.
Now, three thousand years later, Jinwol awakens, but he is no longer on Earth.…

In a dangerous world teeming with monsters at every turn, the kingdoms placed their hopes in the System Users, powerful adventurers who grew stronger faster than anyone else. Among them was Novis, one of the most righteous of all.
But when a quest goes horribly wrong, Novis’s system becomes infected... and his first new quest is a thirst for blood.
The world isn't as simple as Novis once bel…

The world's deadliest assassin just got the hardest assignment of his life: babysitting.
After years of bloodshed, legendary hitman William has finally retired. But his peaceful life comes to an end when an old friend entrusts him with his only child, Ko.
At first, the job seems simple. Ko is an energetic 8-year-old with a bucket list inspired by her favorite movies and TV shows. From eating her f…

entries.t: On the Way to Meet Mom
entries.d:
One day, after being discovered in an abandoned house by a rescue team, Mori suddenly finds himself in a children's protection center. Here, he begins to learn a new way of life – one that includes grand care packages sent by a mysterious patron.
But when his closest friend is reunited with her mother and leaves the center, Mori learns for the first time the existence of a mother for every c…

How far would you go for fame and wealth? Fledgling mommy influencer Juyeon Park is desperate to join the ranks of popular internet celebrities. Thanks to a video of her daughter going viral and her “friend” from high school, popular influencer Yehui Kim, she finally gets the chance to join the ultra-exclusive Deep Pink Society, a group made up of former idols, wealthy CEOs, and social…

It’s been seven years since King Heon Lee declared a marriage ban in Joseon after the death of his wife. But one day, he comes across a woman named Sorang Ye who claims she can summon the spirits of the dead. Though Sorang was lying about her spiritual powers, she now has no choice but to put on an act for the king.
As the secrets behind the mysterious death of the king’s wife and Sora…

entries.t: The Tyrant of the Apocalypse Returns
entries.d:
As Hellgates open across the globe, humanity falls, bringing with it the death of Goong Nam’s family. On the edge of a cliff, he loses hold of his beloved daughter’s hand as she falls straight into the jaws of a fiend. He wishes to reach out one more time with his shattered arm and grab her hand. He wishes to turn back time. 
These wishes can be granted, but for a price: completing a l…

Althea -- heiress to the Loviatar crime syndicate -- has been playing a cat and mouse game with the duke and head Jupiter agent Damien Reed for years. The phantom thief has stolen art, gems, secrets and gotten away without a trace. But the one thing she can't get away from is her father's control. So she has no choice but to accept when he offers up this impossible bargain: impersonate Damien's fi…

Balls, operas, beautiful ladies in silk and muslin, footmen, cadets, love, champagne, Parisian sunsets, alleys, funny pranks and walks, Schubert's waltzes, Indian tea aroma, poems in thick volumes and the sparkle of unfamiliar eyes. How to find yourself among all these new things? How not to lose yourself?

Murdered on her wedding day, Alena returns as a ghost to kill the mastermind of her assassination: her very own groom. What happens when her target is not only the most powerful man in the kingdom but could also see and touch a ghost? His touch unraveled sensations she was supposed to never feel again. But Alena is determined to fulfill her dying wish and not even the mysterious duke’s allur…

entries.t: The Heavenly Demon Wants a Quiet Life
entries.d: After a lifetime of bloodshed, the Heavenly Demon longs for peace. In his final moments, he uncovers the truth about his power and yearns for a different life. He wakes up in the body of Taesan Byeok, the frail second son of a powerful merchant family, barely clinging to life. Using his knowledge from his life as the Heavenly Demon, Taesan must navigate a world of temptation and corruption to surv…

Eliano, the daughter of a powerful duke, marries the seventh prince of Jakador, and they fall in love. But their happiness is short-lived when the prince ascends to the throne. After suffering a miscarriage, she is cruelly poisoned by her husband and dies. Eliano miraculously wakes up to find herself 21 years old and is now determined to avoid the tragic future she once lived. Will she be able to …

Ari is a headless grim reaper who has been guiding souls to the afterlife for hundreds of years. She has always felt unseen and unloved because no one can see her face. That all changes when she encounters Ucheol, a popular actor who can see her head and agrees to help her search for it. Will Ari find her missing head and reclaim her identity, finally freeing herself from a lifetime of loneliness?

Gyeo-ul has lucked into a marriage with a rich, handsome, and kind man. The catch? She has no idea how it happened.
After an accident wipes out the past year of her memory, Gyeo-ul finds herself living a life she doesn't recognize: Sihu Kang, her sworn enemy, is now her doting spouse, and he won't stop gushing over her.
“Wait, I have to share a bed with this guy? And kiss him, too?! Why does…

Evie Ariatte, a lovely saintess candidate, has her bright future shattered when a sudden curse forces her to answer every question with the truth. This unexpected twist of fate threatens her reputation and jeopardizes her dream of becoming the saintess. As her blunt honesty earns her both friends and enemies, will Evie uncover the hidden truths of Thiendavis and bring about its perfect salvation?

Jiho has a superpower that causes explosions whenever she gets excited, making dating and fun nearly impossible—until she discovers that touching her new neighbor, Yechan, miraculously helps her control her ability. Determined to maintain physical contact without outright harassing him, Jiho embarks on a mission to “seduce” Yechan and become his girlfriend. Along the way, ghostly…

“I’m gonna live a normal life!”
 Cho-eun, the heir to the powerful underground clan, Hongsal, has entered university.
 Her only wish? To make lots of friends and enjoy a peaceful, ordinary college life. But who are these four mysterious guys constantly hanging around her?
 'Are you my enemy? My ally? Or... do you like me?'
 Thrown into a whirlwind of emotions at twenty, can Cho-e…

entries.t: The Merman Trapped in My Lake
entries.d:
Servaine Noxirel was never easily pleased, but that changed when her father gifted her a merman, named Mel. Mel became Servaine’s entire world, but as Servaine’s health worsened and before her death, she confessed her love but never heard his answer.

A century passes by and, Mel, now a human, instantly recognizes Servaine’s great grandniece, whose resemblance matches that of her…

Dismissed as incompetent and neglected by her family, the Duke’s daughter, Elsha, is suddenly ordered to marry the infamous Archduke Iceberg—a war hero feared for his ruthless reputation. Rather than despair, she seizes this chance for a fresh start. But upon arriving at his manor, she finds the Archduke missing and is instead met by his wary adopted sons, Wilbert and Hugh—who ha…

In a war against demons for the fate of the world, even three chances at life may not suffice. Such is the fate of Lady Sacred Beryl, a divine maiden tasked with rooting out demonic corruption, only to be murdered and travel back in time -- twice. Upon her third attempt, Beryl realizes the truth: Her only hope to purify the realm is to face the fearsome House Vine, a lair of demons in mortal guise…

The RPG “Lost Story” not only allows players to interact with NPCs but also introduces a new system to rank your closeness with them. With this update, the hero discovers that his relationship with Emma, one of the guild receptionists, is maxed out—even though that shouldn’t be possible! Despite being level 99, Emma always worries whenever he leaves, no matter how much he t…

entries.t: In the Shadow of the Spring
entries.d: Chahee finds herself being forced to return to her hometown of Cheongna, where she practically ran away from after graduating high school. The reality of her family's poverty and misfortunes begin to overwhelm her, all while her first love and ex-boyfriend Wookyeong insists on coming back into her life. She was the one who broke his heart, but he seems to still have feelings for her, flirting with…

300 years. That was how long it had been since he had last been opened. For 3 whole centuries, the mysterious book of magic, also known as Grimoire, has been stuck on the shelf of the Le Temis Royal Academy Library. Just then, an apprentice mage opens the Grimoire, only to die in a freak accident. As the dismayed Grimoire awaits his teleportation to a new location, the library door creeps open and…

Yoonseol Choi, a business student and orphan, lives with her beloved grandfather. But when he falls gravely ill, her whole world is shaken. Before his time runs out, his final wish is to see her marry a good man. Determined to fulfill his request at any cost, Yoonseol embarks on a desperate search for a suitable husband. Love was never her priority, but could an unexpected romance change her heart…

Following the brutal Virtuous-Demonic War, the Demon Cult emerges victorious, seizing control of the world. But their triumph is shaken when the Cult’s vice-leader is assassinated in a sinister conspiracy. From the shadows emerges Ryeon-hwi Hyeok, Crown Prince of the Demon Cult. Determined to uncover the truth and avenge his brother, he infiltrates the elite Academy of Mirages. There, he cro…

Wrapped in a mane as bright as light and covered in fur as dark as the night, Clevatess oversees his territory as one of the Four Lords of Dark Beasts. His life, however, takes a sharp turn when he adopts a humanoid baby and revives a hero he slew following fiery destructions and deaths. What fate awaits the trio in their journey?

Betrayed by love and cast aside by society, Liz finds herself at the edge of despair, with nothing left but her tragic fate. As darkness slowly closes in around her, a flicker of hope appears – a chance to reclaim her life and rewrite her story. Should the naive girl who once believed in love’s promises face her cruel destiny, or transform into a force of vengeance against those who de…

entries.t: I'll Take That Marriage This Time
entries.d:
Adored by her noble family, Saina Devof had a perfect life until one night ruined her societal debut, her family’s honor, and her future in one fell swoop. Determined to fix her mistake, she chooses to marry the man from that night, only to find herself trapped in a nightmare that ended with her lonely death.
Then, she woke up. 18 years old again with a second chance at life, Saina swears of…

Upbeat witch doctor Kina Witchwood receives an ominous prophecy: she will face her execution in six months, but not before encountering three men--one she cannot refuse, one she cannot persuade, and one to whom she will vow her life. Though she tries to defy fate, she soon finds herself appointed as the emperor's personal physician and thrust into the heart of the imperial palace's trecherous poli…

entries.t: The Knight Becomes a Black Flower
entries.d: Diana Lesley, a renowned knight of the Agripana Kingdom, is killed by her rival Cornelius Heimann in the war against the Heverunia Empire. However, when she wakes up, she finds herself at 10 years old and decides to pursue the life of a proper lady instead of a knight—much to her family's disapproval. After becoming Princess Juliana's lady-in-waiting, she must contend with conniving noblewom…

Yeong, nicknamed “Contest God” for her middle school wins, faces a chaotic start to high school when a contest with a huge prize is announced. The catch? It requires a six-person team. After a class project forces Yeong, her best friend Hana, and four unlikely teammates together, Yeong learns about the challenges of teamwork. But when the prize money doubles, the mismatched group decid…

Legend says the God of the Afterlife gave his heart to one human girl to keep her as his eternal bride. Their love is loyal, their love is forever, and their love is a prison for the eighth reincarnation of Mei Shi. Raised in a secluded shrine to become the perfect bride, Mei Shi refuses to be humanity’s peace offering to the Afterworld any longer, especially after discovering the God of the…

Fabre, a famous million-viewer streamer known for his daring encounters with venomous creatures, is bitten by a black mamba while filming in Africa and wakes up in the mystical world of Murim. To his surprise, the jungles of Murim offer him a peaceful farming life in which he enjoys cultivating various poisonous species. But his tranquility is short-lived when he crosses paths with members of the …

Kill monsters, save your neighbors, and expand your domain, all from the comfort of your couch. 
When his city becomes infested with monsters, Jaehyeon discovers an ability that makes him the absolute master of his apartment building. But his ability comes with a catch -- he cannot leave his apartment. Now, he must arm his neighbors and lead them beyond their building to survive the post-apocalypt…

As if being framed by her love for plotting a murder weren’t enough, Rinette learns that her stepsister, Kanna, is the true mastermind behind it all. As she’s burned at the stake, Rinette makes a desperate wish for another chance…and wakes up as her younger self. Determined to change her fate, she vows to stop Kanna’s schemes and protect her family this time around. But re…

entries.t: My Status Window Went on Strike
entries.d: Monsters pour out of gates, wreaking havoc on the world, but Taejun couldn’t care less. After seven years of failure and bullying in his hunter’s guild, he’s fired—until his dormant S-Tier power suddenly activates. Now, with newfound strength, Taejun hunts monsters, exacts brutal revenge, and rises to fame. But as his power grows, so does the danger, and shadowy forces begi…

Seonu Kang single-handedly takes down a group of illegal loan sharks who show up at his house. While being treated at the hospital, he encounters a mysterious man who offers him an invitation to a suspicious secret fighting tournament with a massive cash prize. 
The prize money is his only hope to save his family. Seonu must survive in the combat ward at all costs! Will he be able to defeat all ot…

The academy where Amon was assigned as a new teacher has gone bankrupt! The principal is addicted to gambling, the teachers are no-goods, and the students are lethargic! How will Amon tread forth as he stands at the crossroads of escape and success? A comedic fantasy series that will make your sides hurt from laughing!

entries.t: The Fallen Sage Rises to Power
entries.d: In a world where dungeons and monsters appeared one day and people began to develop special powers, Yuto Kirishima is an orphan and an F-Rank adventurer who is forced to join lower-level raids to make ends meet as he supports his younger sister, Arisa. When his guild tries to turn him into a human sacrifice, he instead awakens to an overwhelming new power! As he uses this legendary sage skill to r…

A spinoff of “Time-Limited Genius Dark Knight.”
Leon von Marbas had no choice but to execute his father when his house was defeated in a war. Though chosen as the new lord, the renown and strength of the mighty Marbas necromancy has dwindled, and the weight of the declining clan is much too heavy for 14-year-old Leon to bear. In a time of despair, however, Marbas the Black Lion, the de…

When doomed to get the bad ending, everyone would try to avoid it no matter what, right? But, that’s not the case for A-Min Kim. 
Reborn as Jayna Blake, the main character of her favorite game: “How to Fall in Love with the Obsessed Man”, A-min Kim is determined to get the locked up ending. Free food, limitless sleep, and no need to work! Who’d refuse that? At least, not Ja…

Aylah Goldwyn’s destiny had been determined since her birth: she was to marry the crown prince. However, on the day after her wedding, the prince asks for their marriage to be dissolved. Now, she suffers from near-constant headaches and insomnia, made bearable only through the embrace of a man. One night, she discovers a man who can make her headaches disappear entirely with nothing but a to…

entries.t: I've Fallen for the Empire's Greatest Villainess
entries.d: There’s a price to be paid for a seemingly perfect life. For Raven, the dashing young son of a duke tasked with guarding the empire, marriage represents nothing but a downward spiral into misery. Cherishing his freedom as a bachelor, Raven is perplexed when the daughter of rival House Sharen makes him a daring proposal of marriage. But there’s a hitch: Lady Estrella Sharen is an infamo…

Gifted by the heavens yet cursed by fate, Yeonshin was born with unimaginable talent in martial arts. But this very gift condemned him to a life that would end before adulthood. With the right opportunities, he had the potential to become a legendary hero, or the reincarnation of the Heavenly Demon. Yet fate cast him into the third-rate Jeong Clan, a family of no particular renown. Now, with time …

entries.t: For the Princess Who Will Disappear
entries.d:
You’re saying that I, a barmaid who grew up on the streets, might be the princess…?!
After pawning off a necklace, Sasha finds herself embroiled in a game of politics and enters the Imperial Palace as the long-lost Princess Anastasia. The secretive romance between Sasha, a shrewd and daring back-alley-raised “princess,” and the stern Duke Lascan, fiancé to the missi…

Su-a, a college freshman in Creative Writing, struggles to understand and express her emotions, leaving her isolated from those around her. When she meets Taeyang, a second-year Sports Coaching student who can sense emotions through touch, their unexpected connection sparks a journey of discovery. Paired for a class assignment that involves a "date," their bond deepens.
This is a story about a man…

When the going gets tough, the tough get going. But what if sooner or later, we hit a ceiling and can’t soar any higher? For Hoji Park, a young sports climber with grand ambitions, it’s difficult to accept that our limitations are set in stone. When her mother passes away from a tragic accident, Hoji begins to see a literal manifestation of her limits in the form of a dark barrier acro…

High school student Sanho, blessed with extraordinary intuition, finds himself caught in a battle between monsters only he can see, nearly losing his life. He awakens in a world where monsters keep humans as pets. Now trapped as a pet himself, Sanho desperately searches for a way to escape and return home. Will he be able to find his way back home?

"Gamemaster," a high school streamer, dedicated his life to beating the supposedly unbeatable game "Hero's Destiny." Finally succeeding after ten years, the realization that he's wasted his life is short-lived, as the game asks him to keep playing—only for him to wake up inside the game after he agrees, in the body of Callix Szcecin, the meek young son of a count. Together with Lyla, the mai…

entries.t: It Wasn't Love at First Sight
entries.d: Eunjae Seo, a not-so-fortunate member of a wealthy conglomerate family, goes on a blind date with Shi-u Yun, whom her grandfather arranged for her to marry. Initially wary of Shi-u due to his bad reputation, Eunjae starts warming up to him as Shi-u confesses he fell in love with her at first sight. She ends up falling deeply in love with him. The two seem to be a happy couple, until Shi-u begins t…

Gang-in Na wakes up in the year 2024 in the middle of South Korea with no memory of where or who he is.

Upon hearing a voice that sounds strangely familiar, he comes face to face with a robot named ACE (Autonomous Combat Entity), who informs him that he was once part of the Earth Federation Forces in the year 2082 and possesses a wide array of skills.

Gang-in decides to join forces with ACE to r…

Have you ever been so angry that you wanted to break the laws of physics and throw down with a cosmic being? Well, you might if you’re Great—no, not “great”; I mean Great the Executioner. On planet Graymark, where the law decrees that all sinners must die, Great makes a name for himself butchering criminals in their thousands. Except now the law is no more, and Great must s…

Jaerim, a.k.a. the “Executioner”, the most fearsome villain of all, is about to marry his civilian girlfriend! But before they can say “I do”, he has to survive life with her family, who just so happen to be the most powerful superhero clan. Can he keep his identity a secret and convince them that he’s the perfect son-in-law?

Yunjae Park thought his relationship with his girlfriend, Ji-eun, was perfect--until one shocking morning changed everything. Ji-eun has mysteriously transformed into a man overnight! Can the two adjust to this sudden and earth-shattering change? And will Ji-eun ever turn back to who she once was?!

"The Survival of Humanity in a Submerged Earth"

The endless monsoon began when an icy comet collided with the Moon, triggering a catastrophic flood on Earth. 

For 70 years, unrelenting rain fell, ultimately submerging the entire planet.Having lost their land, humanity's survival now depends on life at sea. The once-dominant species that ruled the Earth is no more. Sea creatures, mutated into gro…

Jintae Seo and his younger sister Jina, a purple-eyed albino, are separated after being kidnapped by human traffickers. After two years of torment, Jintae is rescued by an assassin named Shin Kim. After years of training, Jintae, now an assassin himself, follows a lead to Hong Kong to find his sister. After accidentally getting involved in a gang war, it is revealed that Jina is apparently an assa…

entries.t: The Roguish Guard in a Medieval Fantasy
entries.d: In a brutal medieval world where innocence means life and guilt means death, Aron, captain of the castle guard, enforces order within the fortress. But when demons begin to corrupt men’s hearts, violent events erupt, including repeated attempts to assassinate the lady of the castle. As Aron hunts the culprits, he encounters a demon that marks him, granting incredible strength but tainting hi…

After being joyfully reunited with Jinhan Ryu, the best friend of her brother, Hayeon Ji’s day immediately takes a turn for the worse as the two witness her boyfriend with another woman, right in front of them.
After a series of awkward, coincidental encounters between the two, Hayeon and Jinhan begin to get reacquainted with one another. But after spending some time together, Jinhan seems t…

entries.t: Locked Up by My Mad Dog
entries.d:
After dying and being reborn as Elizabeth, a character from a dark fantasy novel, the new “Elizabeth” begins to navigate her new life.

Set to be married to the empire’s crown prince, the new Elizabeth can’t believe her luck. But just as she’s getting ready for a life on easy street, the dark secrets of the previous “Elizabeth” begin to come to light. 

Le…

In a world where humanity battles monsters with powerful weapons called Relics, Hinata Asahi is the ultimate underdog at Valkyria Academy, a school for training warriors. Mocked for his relic, a gimmicky suit that looks like a comic book costume, and bullied by classmates, no one knows it holds a secret. The more he is pushed down, the stronger it becomes. Driven by his father’s legacy, Hina…

Twenty years have passed since the Great War, but petty theft and exploitation have taken root during times of peace. The once dazzling world of Murim is a mere shadow of its former self, but one young enigmatic swordsman has sworn to restore Jianghu to its former glory. Will the noble principles of justice and loyalty prevail over corruption and greed?

How far would you be willing to go for love? 
The unavoidable temptation to destroy one’s deepening love is an age-old dilemma for many. This provocative collection of love stories will show you how dangerous passion can sometimes be.

Qi, swords, martial artists… and robots and spaceships?! The year is 3077, thousands of years after the heyday of the martial arts realm. Humanity inhabits the stars, governed by interstellar martial arts organizations who kept the old ways of the realm alive: might makes right! For bounty hunters like Seryeong, Robert, and Sunja, this means trouble is good for business, except when they bi…

Rudd’s a nobody-- just an E-Rank adventurer with a seemingly useless talent of status immunity. 
An outcast in a city obsessed with labyrinth crawling, he’s stuck scraping by as a “grubby forager,” navigating guild politics and backstabbing adventurers just to survive. 
But when a betrayal leaves him for dead without any supplies or help, he does the unthinkable and consume…

“I shall destroy the factions of justice and avenge the deaths of my comrades!” Jeonghwa, the captain of the Black Serpent Squad, loses everyone she grew up with when the lawful factions betray them after the battle against the chaotic factions. On the verge of death herself, she must now claw her way up to deliver true justice to the so-called justice factions.

Five years have passed since a blameless infant was spared from a demonstration, saved by her parents' self-sacrifice. Yet what should have ended the religious hysteria has instead fueled a new wave of feverish cult practices by the ever-growing Arrowhead. As society teeters on the brink of further chaos and long-dead sinners inexplicably begin returning to life, the government steps in behind the…

An overworked game developer dies and is reincarnated as the weakest character in the game he created himself. Challenged by Jaeseokcheon, the ruler of the game universe, he must complete a series of quests to survive and prevent a second death. Epic battles between monsters, celestial beings with magic powers, and Jaeseokcheon ensue. In this tug-of-war between the omniscient game designer and the…

In a cynical world where love has lost its luster, 37-year-old Hayeong Kim is merely a shell of her former self. But in a twist of fate, she’s catapulted back in time, inhabiting the body and vibrant spirit of her 17-year-old self, Seon Kim, and reliving an era of passionate love and limitless potential. Empowered by her knowledge of what’s to come, Seon embarks on a mission to reshape…

What would you do if you suddenly regained memories of your past life and realized you were living in a world that was once a game you played? Jinfrey chooses to use his knowledge as an OG gamer and exploit the game’s secrets so he can become an unparalleled adventurer. But he’ll have to be careful because if he dies, it’s game over! Will he be able to find all of the hidden rank…

entries.t: A Flower Blooms on the Wall
entries.d: “Of course I recognized you. You’re my first love.” Living a life of being stalked by her first love, Dam Do is visited by her brother’s friend Yun Oh. No longer the boy next door who used to follow her around like a puppy, Yun is now a man, and he acts strangely aloof around her. While Dam has found herself resenting her first love, Yun is secretly quite excited to be arou…

Feeling down? Stop by Cunimaru – a cozy shop where souls waiting for reincarnation gather to reminisce about their happiest memories. Savor a warm cup of tea and join Jiun Lee, Cunimaru’s new owner, as she embarks on a journey of healing, both for herself and her new friends, while unraveling the mysteries of this whimsical afterlife retreat.

Gihu, a high schooler with a passion for photographing the sky, dreams of entering a photography contest. However, the contest requires a portrait photo, which he’s terrible at. He enlists the help of Haneul, a mysterious new transfer student who accidentally appears in one of Gihu’s sky photos. Despite his struggles, he finds himself wanting to take more photos of her. As they prepare…

Juyeong Nam, the boss of a multinational corporation, has been doing his best to defy the fate of a super-rich male lead, only to be swept off his feet by a princess falling from the sky! Will he succeed in returning this princess, with her strange hair color and even stranger personality, to her world safely?

Scared? Not yet? We’ll see about that! Welcome to the Circus, where monsters feast on your greatest fears, then send you home. Chip the clown does his very best to frighten Raylee, but she is, tragically, fearless! Surely there’s a phobia out there just for her.

When a dead officer’s badge falls into Vano Grice’s hands, he enters the city’s hidden war with soul devouring Shadows. The badge links him to the SDU, a monster hunting organization where his sister Cleo serves.
